fields.name: CROSS_CPU_HALT_SENSITIVITY
fields.text: How a halt passes between the CPUs: 0 level-triggered, 1 pulse-triggered. Retained.

fields.name: SYS_CPUWAIT_ON_JTAG
fields.text: 1 holds the core stalled coming out of reset, only after a wake-up caused by JTAG; the debugger can still access it, and writing 0 lets the core run. Works regardless of the PDC settings; with this bit set, SW/JTAG activity in deep sleep leaves the SYS CPU stalled after waking. Retained.

fields.name: SYS_CPUWAIT
fields.text: 1 holds the core stalled coming out of reset after every wake-up; the debugger can still access it, and writing 0 lets the core run. Retained.

fields.name: CMAC_CPU_IS_HALTED
fields.text: Reads 1 while the CMAC CPU is halted.

fields.name: SYS_CPU_IS_HALTED
fields.text: Reads 1 while the SYS CPU (Cortex-M33) is halted.

fields.name: HALT_CMAC_SYS_CPU_EN
fields.text: 1 lets a halt of the CMAC CPU halt the SYS CPU (Cortex-M33). Retained; clear it before deep sleep, or halting after wake-up is unpredictable.

fields.name: HALT_SYS_CMAC_CPU_EN
fields.text: 1 lets a halt of the SYS CPU (Cortex-M33) halt the CMAC CPU. Retained; clear it before deep sleep, or halting after wake-up is unpredictable.

fields.name: CMAC_CPU_FREEZE_EN
fields.text: 1 lets the CMAC CPU freeze the on-chip peripherals listed in SET_FREEZE_REG and RESET_FREEZE_REG. Retained.

fields.name: SYS_CPU_FREEZE_EN
fields.text: 1 (reset state) freezes the on-chip peripherals listed in SET_FREEZE_REG and RESET_FREEZE_REG while the Cortex-M33 is halted in debug state; at 0 their freezing follows only SET_FREEZE_REG and RESET_FREEZE_REG. The system watchdog freezes whenever the Cortex-M33 is halted in debug state, either way. Retained.

fields.name: CAL_PHASE
fields.text: Reads 1 when the chip is in its calibration phase: OTP programmed, calibration not yet done.

fields.name: CMAC_H2H_BRIDGE_BYPASS
fields.text: 1 bypasses the AHB-to-AHB bridge, cutting wait cycles on CMAC register file access; takes effect only with the XTAL as system clock and both hclk and cmac_hclk at 32 MHz.

fields.name: USBPHY_FORCE_SW2_ON
fields.text: Forces the USBP pull-up switch SW2 on (2.3 kohm) instead of leaving it to the USB controller.

values.text: SW2 under USB controller control; off while the USB is disabled.

fields.name: USBPHY_FORCE_SW1_OFF
fields.text: Forces the USBP pull-up switch SW1 off instead of leaving it to the USB controller.

values.text: SW1 under USB controller control; off while the USB is disabled.

fields.name: USBPAD_EN
fields.text: Forces power on for the USB PHY and USB pads instead of only while the USB is enabled.

values.text: USB PHY and pads powered when the USB is enabled.
USB PHY and pads always powered.

fields.name: I2C_STOP_DET_IF_MASTER_ACTIVE
fields.text: Master mode: 1 raises STOP_DET only while the master is active; 0 raises it whether or not the master is active.

fields.name: I2C_RX_FIFO_FULL_HLD_CTRL
fields.text: What happens once the RX FIFO has filled to its RX_BUFFER_DEPTH: 1 the bus is held; 0 the FIFO overflows.

fields.name: I2C_TX_EMPTY_CTRL
fields.text: TX_EMPTY interrupt generation: 1 controlled generation; 0 default behaviour.

fields.name: I2C_STOP_DET_IFADDRESSED
fields.text: Slave STOP_DET: 1 raises it only when addressed; 0 raises it always. With 1, a general call does not raise STOP_DET even when the slave ACKs it; only a match with the slave address (SAR) does.

fields.name: I2C_SLAVE_DISABLE
fields.text: Whether the slave is enabled out of reset, so it needs no configuration: 0 enabled, 1 disabled. When this bit is written 0, bit 0 is to be written 0 too.

fields.name: I2C_RESTART_EN
fields.text: Lets the master send RESTART conditions: 0 disabled, 1 enabled.

fields.name: I2C_10BITADDR_MASTER
fields.text: Address width the master starts its transfers with: 0 7-bit, 1 10-bit.

fields.name: I2C_10BITADDR_SLAVE
fields.text: Address width the slave answers to: 0 7-bit, 1 10-bit.

fields.name: I2C_SPEED
fields.text: Bus speed: 1 100 kbit/s (standard), 2 400 kbit/s (fast), 3 high speed.

fields.name: I2C_MASTER_MODE
fields.text: Master enable: 0 disabled, 1 enabled. When this bit is written 1, bit 6 is to be written 1 too.

fields.name: SPECIAL
fields.text: Read: 0 ignores GC_OR_START and uses the target address normally; 1 performs the special command GC_OR_START selects. Write: 1 enables, 0 disables programming a General Call or START byte. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0.

fields.name: GC_OR_START
fields.text: With SPECIAL at 1, picks the special command: 0 General Call, after which only writes are allowed (a read sets TX_ABRT, bit 6 of IC_RAW_INTR_STAT) until SPECIAL is cleared; 1 START byte. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0.

fields.name: IC_TAR
fields.text: Target address of every master transfer; ignored for a General Call, and written once to make a START BYTE. With IC_TAR equal to IC_SAR the master and slave share the FIFOs, so only one-way (simplex) loopback works; a master can send only to a slave, not to itself. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0.

fields.name: IC_SAR
fields.text: Slave address used while the I2C runs as a slave; 7-bit addressing uses only IC_SAR[6:0]. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0 and are ignored otherwise.

fields.name: I2C_IC_HS_MAR
fields.text: This master's high-speed master code, 0 to 7. HS master codes are reserved 8-bit codes (00001xxx) not used for slave addresses; each master has its own, so up to eight HS masters can share a bus. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0 and are ignored otherwise.

fields.name: I2C_RESTART
fields.text: RESTART before this byte. 1: with IC_RESTART_EN at 1, a RESTART is always sent before the byte, direction change or not. 0: with IC_RESTART_EN at 1, a RESTART is sent only when the direction changes from the previous command. With IC_RESTART_EN at 0, a STOP then a START is sent in place of the RESTART in both cases.

fields.name: I2C_STOP
fields.text: STOP after this byte. 1: a STOP follows the byte whatever the TX FIFO holds; if the FIFO is not empty the master then sends a START and arbitrates for the bus again. 0: no STOP follows; if the FIFO is not empty the transfer continues per CMD, and if it is empty the master holds SCL low until a new command arrives.

fields.name: I2C_CMD
fields.text: Master transfer direction for this command: 1 read, 0 write; it has no effect on direction as a slave. Slave-receiver: don't care. Slave-transmitter: 0 sends the data in DAT. A read after a General Call raises TX_ABRT (bit 6 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT_REG) unless SPECIAL (I2C_TAR bit 11) was cleared; writing 1 after a RD_REQ interrupt raises TX_ABRT. If a RD_REQ arrives while a master read is being attempted, the write here is ignored, TX_ABRT is raised and the RD_REQ is served.

fields.name: I2C_DAT
fields.text: Byte sent or received on the bus. Ignored on a write that asks for a read; a read returns the byte received.

fields.name: IC_SS_SCL_HCNT
fields.text: SCL high-period count for standard speed; set before any bus transfer for correct I/O timing. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE is 0. Minimum 6: a smaller write sets 6. Must not exceed 65525, since a 16-bit counter flags bus idle at IC_SS_SCL_HCNT + 10.

fields.name: IC_SS_SCL_LCNT
fields.text: SCL low-period count for standard speed; set before any bus transfer for correct I/O timing. Writes take effect only while I2C_ENABLE is 0. Minimum 8: a smaller write sets 8.

fields.name: IC_FS_SCL_HCNT
fields.text: SCL high-period count for fast speed; in high-speed mode it also times the master code, START BYTE and General Call. Set before any bus transfer. Writes take effect only while I2C_ENABLE is 0. Minimum 6: a smaller write sets 6.

fields.name: IC_FS_SCL_LCNT
fields.text: SCL low-period count for fast speed; in high-speed mode it also times the master code, START BYTE and General Call. Set before any bus transfer. Writes take effect only while I2C_ENABLE is 0. Minimum 8: a smaller write sets 8. With APB_DATA_WIDTH = 8, write the lower byte first, then the upper byte.

fields.name: IC_HS_SCL_HCNT
fields.text: SCL high-period count for high speed; set before any bus transfer. SCL high time depends on bus load: 60 ns at 100 pF, 120 ns at 400 pF. Reads 0 and is read-only when IC_MAX_SPEED_MODE is not high. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0. Minimum 6: a smaller write sets 6. With APB_DATA_WIDTH = 8, write the lower byte first, then the upper byte.

fields.name: IC_HS_SCL_LCNT
fields.text: SCL low-period count for high speed; set before any bus transfer. SCL low time depends on bus load: 160 ns at 100 pF, 320 ns at 400 pF. Reads 0 and is read-only when IC_MAX_SPEED_MODE is not high. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0. Minimum 8: a smaller write sets 8. With APB_DATA_WIDTH = 8, write the lower byte first, then the upper byte.

fields.name: R_SCL_STUCK_AT_LOW
fields.text: SCL stuck at low interrupt status.

fields.name: R_MASTER_ON_HOLD
fields.text: Shows the master holding the bus with the TX FIFO empty. Needs both IC_EMPTYFIFO_HOLD_MASTER_EN=1 and I2C_DYNAMIC_TAR_UPDATE=1.

fields.name: R_RESTART_DET
fields.text: Shows a RESTART on the bus while in slave mode and addressed. Works only with IC_SLV_RESTART_DET_EN=1. In high-speed mode or a START BYTE transfer the RESTART precedes the address, so the slave is not yet addressed and no RESTART_DET is raised.

fields.name: R_GEN_CALL
fields.text: Set only when a General Call address arrives and is ACKed; the received data goes to the RX buffer. Cleared by disabling the controller or by the CPU reading bit 0 of I2C_CLR_GEN_CALL.

fields.name: R_START_DET
fields.text: Shows a START or RESTART on the bus, in slave or master mode.

fields.name: R_STOP_DET
fields.text: Shows a STOP on the bus, in slave or master mode.

fields.name: R_ACTIVITY
fields.text: Records bus activity and stays set, even once the controller is idle, until cleared by disabling the controller, reading IC_CLR_ACTIVITY, reading IC_CLR_INTR, or a system reset.

fields.name: R_RX_DONE
fields.text: As slave-transmitter, set to 1 when the master does not ACK a sent byte; this happens on the last byte and marks the end of the transfer.

fields.name: R_TX_ABRT
fields.text: Set when the controller, as master or slave transmitter, cannot finish what the TX FIFO holds (a transmit abort); I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE gives the cause. While set the TX FIFO is flushed, and it stays flushed until I2C_CLR_TX_ABRT is read; it then takes data from the APB again.

fields.name: R_RD_REQ
fields.text: Set to 1 when, as slave, a remote master asks to read data; SCL is held low until it is served. The processor then writes the data to I2C_DATA_CMD. Cleared just after the processor reads I2C_CLR_RD_REQ.

fields.name: R_TX_EMPTY
fields.text: Set to 1 when the TX buffer is at or below the I2C_TX_TL threshold; cleared by hardware once it rises above. With IC_ENABLE bit 0 at 0 the TX FIFO is emptied and kept in reset, so it looks empty: this bit is 1 while the master or slave state machine is active and 0 once activity ends.

fields.name: R_TX_OVER
fields.text: Set when the TX buffer holds 32 and the processor writes another command to IC_DATA_CMD. When the module is disabled it keeps its level until the state machines are idle, then clears as ic_en goes 0.

fields.name: R_RX_FULL
fields.text: Set when the RX buffer reaches or passes the RX_TL threshold in I2C_RX_TL; cleared by hardware once it falls below. Writing 0 to I2C_ENABLE bit 0 flushes the RX FIFO and holds it in reset, which clears this bit whatever activity continues.

fields.name: R_RX_OVER
fields.text: Set when the RX buffer holds 32 and another byte arrives from an external device; the byte is ACKed but lost. With I2C_ENABLE[0]=0 it keeps its level until the state machines are idle, then clears as ic_en goes 0.

fields.name: R_RX_UNDER
fields.text: Set when the processor reads IC_DATA_CMD with the RX buffer empty. With I2C_ENABLE[0]=0 it keeps its level until the state machines are idle, then clears as ic_en goes 0.

fields.name: M_SCL_STUCK_AT_LOW
fields.text: Mask for SCL_STUCK_AT_LOW; reserved.

fields.name: M_MASTER_ON_HOLD
fields.text: Masks MASTER_ON_HOLD in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_RESTART_DET
fields.text: Masks RESTART_DET in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_GEN_CALL
fields.text: Masks GEN_CALL in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_START_DET
fields.text: Masks START_DET in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_STOP_DET
fields.text: Masks STOP_DET in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_ACTIVITY
fields.text: Masks ACTIVITY in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_RX_DONE
fields.text: Masks RX_DONE in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_TX_ABRT
fields.text: Masks TX_ABRT in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_RD_REQ
fields.text: Masks RD_REQ in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_TX_EMPTY
fields.text: Masks TX_EMPTY in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_TX_OVER
fields.text: Masks TX_OVER in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_RX_FULL
fields.text: Masks RX_FULL in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_RX_OVER
fields.text: Masks RX_OVER in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_RX_UNDER
fields.text: Masks RX_UNDER in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: SCL_STUCK_AT_LOW
fields.text: SCL stuck low, raw status; reserved.

fields.name: MASTER_ON_HOLD
fields.text: Raw: master holding the bus with the TX FIFO empty. Needs both IC_EMPTYFIFO_HOLD_MASTER_EN=1 and I2C_DYNAMIC_TAR_UPDATE=1.

fields.name: RESTART_DET
fields.text: Raw: a RESTART on the bus while in slave mode and addressed. Works only with IC_SLV_RESTART_DET_EN=1. In high-speed mode or a START BYTE transfer the RESTART precedes the address, so the slave is not yet addressed and no RESTART_DET is raised.

fields.name: GEN_CALL
fields.text: Raw: set only when a General Call address arrives and is ACKed; the data goes to the RX buffer. Cleared by disabling the controller or by the CPU reading bit 0 of I2C_CLR_GEN_CALL.

fields.name: START_DET
fields.text: Raw: a START or RESTART on the bus, in slave or master mode.

fields.name: STOP_DET
fields.text: Raw: a STOP on the bus, in slave or master mode.

fields.name: ACTIVITY
fields.text: Raw: records bus activity and stays set, even once idle, until cleared by disabling the controller, reading IC_CLR_ACTIVITY, reading IC_CLR_INTR, or a system reset.

fields.name: RX_DONE
fields.text: Raw: as slave-transmitter, set to 1 when the master does not ACK a sent byte, which happens on the last byte and ends the transfer.

fields.name: TX_ABRT
fields.text: Raw: set when the controller, as master or slave transmitter, cannot finish what the TX FIFO holds (a transmit abort); I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE gives the cause. The TX FIFO is flushed while set and stays flushed until I2C_CLR_TX_ABRT is read.

fields.name: RD_REQ
fields.text: Raw: set to 1 when, as slave, a remote master asks to read; SCL is held low until served, and the processor then writes the data to I2C_DATA_CMD. Cleared just after the processor reads I2C_CLR_RD_REQ.

fields.name: TX_EMPTY
fields.text: Raw: 1 when the TX buffer is at or below the I2C_TX_TL threshold; cleared by hardware once above. With IC_ENABLE bit 0 at 0 the flushed FIFO looks empty, so this is 1 while a state machine is active and 0 once activity ends.

fields.name: TX_OVER
fields.text: Raw: set when the TX buffer holds 32 and another command is written to IC_DATA_CMD. When disabled it keeps its level until the state machines are idle, then clears as ic_en goes 0.

fields.name: RX_FULL
fields.text: Raw: set when the RX buffer reaches or passes RX_TL in I2C_RX_TL; cleared by hardware once below. Writing 0 to I2C_ENABLE bit 0 flushes the RX FIFO and clears this bit whatever activity continues.

fields.name: RX_OVER
fields.text: Raw: set when the RX buffer holds 32 and another byte arrives; the byte is ACKed but lost. With I2C_ENABLE[0]=0 it keeps its level until the state machines are idle, then clears as ic_en goes 0.

fields.name: RX_UNDER
fields.text: Raw: set when IC_DATA_CMD is read with the RX buffer empty. With I2C_ENABLE[0]=0 it keeps its level until the state machines are idle, then clears as ic_en goes 0.

fields.name: RX_TL
fields.text: RX FIFO threshold: the entry count at or above which RX_FULL (I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT bit 2) is raised. Range 0-31; 0 means 1 entry, 31 means 32. A value above the buffer depth is set to the depth.

fields.name: TX_TL
fields.text: TX FIFO threshold: the entry count at or below which TX_EMPTY (I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT bit 4) is raised. Range 0-31; 0 means 0 entries, 31 means 32. A value above the buffer depth is set to the depth.

fields.name: CLR_INTR
fields.text: A read clears the combined interrupt, every software-clearable interrupt and I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE; hardware-clearable interrupts are untouched. Bit 9 of I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE is an exception.

fields.name: CLR_RX_UNDER
fields.text: A read clears RX_UNDER (bit 0 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_RX_OVER
fields.text: A read clears RX_OVER (bit 1 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_TX_OVER
fields.text: A read clears TX_OVER (bit 3 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_RD_REQ
fields.text: A read clears RD_REQ (bit 5 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_TX_ABRT
fields.text: A read clears TX_ABRT (bit 6 of IC_RAW_INTR_STAT) and I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE, and lets the TX FIFO out of its flushed state to take writes again. Bit 9 of I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE is an exception.

fields.name: CLR_RX_DONE
fields.text: A read clears RX_DONE (bit 7 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_ACTIVITY
fields.text: A read clears ACTIVITY (bit 8 of IC_RAW_INTR_STAT) if the I2C is no longer active; while still active on the bus the bit stays set. Hardware clears it once the module is disabled and the bus is quiet. The value read gives the ACTIVITY status.

fields.name: CLR_STOP_DET
fields.text: A read clears STOP_DET (bit 9 of IC_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_START_DET
fields.text: A read clears START_DET (bit 10 of IC_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_GEN_CALL
fields.text: A read clears GEN_CALL (bit 11 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: I2C_TX_CMD_BLOCK
fields.text: Master mode: 1 holds off transmission on the bus even with data in the TX FIFO; 0 starts transmission as soon as the first data is in the TX FIFO.

fields.name: I2C_ABORT
fields.text: Writing 1 aborts a master-mode transfer; accepted only while ENABLE is set, and software cannot clear it. The controller ends the current transfer, issues a STOP, flushes the TX FIFO and then raises TX_ABORT; the bit clears itself when the abort is done.

fields.name: I2C_EN
fields.text: Controller enable: 0 disabled, TX and RX FIFOs kept erased; 1 enabled. It may be disabled while active: both FIFOs are flushed, IC_INTR_STAT bits stay active until the controller is idle, a transmit stops after the current transfer and its buffer is cleared, and a receive stops after the current byte without ACK. Enabling or disabling takes two ic_clk cycles.

fields.name: LV_HOLD_RX_FIFO_FULL
fields.text: Slave bus hold because the RX FIFO is full and another byte has arrived: 1 holding for that reason; 0 not holding, or holding for another reason.

fields.name: SLV_HOLD_TX_FIFO_EMPTY
fields.text: Slave bus hold on a read request with the TX FIFO empty, kept until the FIFO has data: 1 holding for that reason; 0 not holding, or holding for another reason.

fields.name: MST_HOLD_RX_FIFO_FULL
fields.text: Master bus hold because the RX FIFO is full and another byte has arrived: 1 holding for that reason; 0 not holding, or holding for another reason.

fields.name: MST_HOLD_TX_FIFO_EMPTY
fields.text: Master bus hold in a write because the TX FIFO is empty and the last command sent had no Stop bit: 1 holding for that reason; 0 not holding, or holding for another reason.

fields.name: SLV_ACTIVITY
fields.text: Slave state machine activity: 1 the slave FSM is out of IDLE (slave side active); 0 it is in IDLE.

fields.name: MST_ACTIVITY
fields.text: Master state machine activity: 1 the master FSM is out of IDLE (master side active); 0 it is in IDLE.

fields.name: RFF
fields.text: Receive FIFO full: 1 every location is used; 0 at least one is free.

fields.name: RFNE
fields.text: Receive FIFO not empty: 1 it holds at least one entry; 0 it is empty.

fields.name: TFE
fields.text: Transmit FIFO empty: 1 it holds no valid entries; 0 it holds at least one. Raises no interrupt.

fields.name: TFNF
fields.text: Transmit FIFO not full: 1 at least one location is free; 0 it is full.

fields.name: I2C_ACTIVITY
fields.text: I2C activity status.

fields.name: TXFLR
fields.text: TX FIFO level: how many valid entries the TX FIFO holds.

fields.name: RXFLR
fields.text: RX FIFO level: how many valid entries the RX FIFO holds.

fields.name: I2C_SDA_RX_HOLD
fields.text: SDA hold time when receiving, in ic_clk periods.

fields.name: I2C_SDA_TX_HOLD
fields.text: SDA hold time when transmitting, in ic_clk periods.

fields.name: ABRT_USER_ABRT
fields.text: Master-transmitter only: the master saw a user abort (IC_ENABLE[1]).

fields.name: ABRT_SLVRD_INTX
fields.text: Slave-transmitter abort: 1 when, answering a remote master's request for data, a 1 was written to CMD (bit 8) of IC_DATA_CMD; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_SLV_ARBLOST
fields.text: Slave-transmitter abort: 1 the slave lost the bus while sending data to a remote master, with bit 12 set alongside; this is a fail-safe check, for example when the data line at an SCL rising edge differs from what was being sent. 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_SLVFLUSH_TXFIFO
fields.text: Slave-transmitter abort: 1 a read command arrived while old data was in the TX FIFO, so TX_ABRT was raised to flush it; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ARB_LOST
fields.text: Master- or slave-transmitter abort: 1 arbitration lost, by the master, or by the slave transmitter when bit 14 is also set (the controller may be master and slave at once); 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_MASTER_DIS
fields.text: Master abort: 1 a master operation was started while master mode was disabled; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_10B_RD_NORSTRT
fields.text: Master-receiver abort: 1 a read was sent in 10-bit addressing mode with RESTART disabled (IC_RESTART_EN, I2C_CON[5], at 0); 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_SBYTE_NORSTRT
fields.text: Master abort: 1 a START byte was attempted with RESTART disabled (I2C_CON[5] at 0); 0 not this case. It clears like the other bits only once its cause is removed (RESTART enabled, SPECIAL I2C_TAR[11] cleared, or GC_OR_START I2C_TAR[10] cleared); cleared earlier, it drops for one cycle and sets again.

fields.name: ABRT_HS_NORSTRT
fields.text: Master abort: 1 a high-speed transfer was attempted with RESTART disabled (I2C_CON[5] at 0); 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_SBYTE_ACKDET
fields.text: Master abort: 1 a START byte that was sent got an ACK, which is wrong behaviour; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_HS_ACKDET
fields.text: Master abort: 1 in high-speed mode the HS master code got an ACK, which is wrong behaviour; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_GCALL_READ
fields.text: Master-transmitter abort: 1 a General Call was sent and the next byte was programmed as a read (IC_DATA_CMD[9] at 1); 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_GCALL_NOACK
fields.text: Master-transmitter abort: 1 a General Call was sent and no slave ACKed it; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_TXDATA_NOACK
fields.text: Master-transmitter abort (master mode only): 1 the address was ACKed but data bytes after it were not; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_10ADDR2_NOACK
fields.text: Master abort in 10-bit address mode: 1 no slave ACKed the second address byte; 0 no such abort.

fields.name: ABRT_10ADDR1_NOACK
fields.text: Master abort in 10-bit address mode: 1 no slave ACKed the first address byte; 0 no such abort.

fields.name: ABRT_7B_ADDR_NOACK
fields.text: Master abort in 7-bit address mode: 1 no slave ACKed the address; 0 no such abort.

fields.name: TDMAE
fields.text: Transmit FIFO DMA channel: 0 disabled, 1 enabled.

fields.name: RDMAE
fields.text: Receive FIFO DMA channel: 0 disabled, 1 enabled.

fields.name: DMATDL
fields.text: Transmit data level: the TX watermark. With TDMAE = 1, dma_tx_req is raised when the TX FIFO holds this many valid entries or fewer.

fields.name: DMARDL
fields.text: Receive data level: the RX watermark is DMARDL+1. With RDMAE = 1, dma_rx_req is raised when the RX FIFO holds DMARDL+1 valid entries or more; at 0, one entry is enough.

fields.name: SDA_SETUP
fields.text: SDA setup: as slave-transmitter serving a read request, the delay in I2C clock periods, made by holding SCL low, between the SCL rising edge and SDA changing; this meets tSU:DAT of the I2C bus. Must be 2 or more; for a 1000 ns delay at a 10 MHz I2C clock the value is 11. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] = 0.

fields.name: ACK_GEN_CALL
fields.text: Reply to a General Call: 1 ACK (ic_data_oe asserted); 0 NACK, and no General Call interrupts.

fields.name: SLV_RX_DATA_LOST
fields.text: 1 a slave-receive transfer with a matching address was cut off by IC_ENABLE going 1 to 0 after its data phase began, even if the byte was NACKed; also set if the remote master ends with STOP before the NACK and IC_ENABLE is 0. 0 disabled without taking part in a slave-receive data phase. Reliable to read once IC_EN (bit 0) reads 0.

fields.name: SLV_DISABLED_WHILE_BUSY
fields.text: 1 a possible or active slave operation was cut off by writing 0 to IC_ENABLE while receiving the address byte of a slave-transmit, or address and data of a slave-receive; the controller forced a NACK whether or not the address matched IC_SAR, or the transfer finished before the disable took effect; also set if the remote master ends with STOP before the NACK and IC_ENABLE is 0. 0 disabled during master activity or an idle bus. Reliable to read once IC_EN (bit 0) reads 0.

fields.name: IC_EN
fields.text: Follows the ic_en output: 1 controller enabled; 0 fully inactive. Readable at any time; when 0, SLV_RX_DATA_LOST and SLV_DISABLED_WHILE_BUSY may be read.

fields.name: I2C_FS_SPKLEN
fields.text: Longest spike on SCL or SDA, in ic_clk cycles, that the spike filter removes; set before any bus transfer. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE is 0. Minimum 1: a smaller write sets 1.

fields.name: I2C_HS_SPKLEN
fields.text: Longest spike on SCL or SDA, in ic_clk cycles, that the spike filter removes; set before any bus transfer. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0. Minimum 1: a smaller write sets 1.

fields.name: I2C_STOP_DET_IF_MASTER_ACTIVE
fields.text: Master mode: 1 raises STOP_DET only while the master is active; 0 raises it whether or not the master is active.

fields.name: I2C_RX_FIFO_FULL_HLD_CTRL
fields.text: What happens once the RX FIFO has filled to its RX_BUFFER_DEPTH: 1 the bus is held; 0 the FIFO overflows.

fields.name: I2C_TX_EMPTY_CTRL
fields.text: TX_EMPTY interrupt generation: 1 controlled generation; 0 default behaviour.

fields.name: I2C_STOP_DET_IFADDRESSED
fields.text: Slave STOP_DET: 1 raises it only when addressed; 0 raises it always. With 1, a general call does not raise STOP_DET even when the slave ACKs it; only a match with the slave address (SAR) does.

fields.name: I2C_SLAVE_DISABLE
fields.text: Whether the slave is enabled out of reset, so it needs no configuration: 0 enabled, 1 disabled. When this bit is written 0, bit 0 is to be written 0 too.

fields.name: I2C_RESTART_EN
fields.text: Lets the master send RESTART conditions: 0 disabled, 1 enabled.

fields.name: I2C_10BITADDR_MASTER
fields.text: Address width the master starts its transfers with: 0 7-bit, 1 10-bit.

fields.name: I2C_10BITADDR_SLAVE
fields.text: Address width the slave answers to: 0 7-bit, 1 10-bit.

fields.name: I2C_SPEED
fields.text: Bus speed: 1 100 kbit/s (standard), 2 400 kbit/s (fast), 3 high speed.

fields.name: I2C_MASTER_MODE
fields.text: Master enable: 0 disabled, 1 enabled. When this bit is written 1, bit 6 is to be written 1 too.

fields.name: SPECIAL
fields.text: Read: 0 ignores GC_OR_START and uses the target address normally; 1 performs the special command GC_OR_START selects. Write: 1 enables, 0 disables programming a General Call or START byte. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0.

fields.name: GC_OR_START
fields.text: With SPECIAL at 1, picks the special command: 0 General Call, after which only writes are allowed (a read sets TX_ABRT, bit 6 of IC_RAW_INTR_STAT) until SPECIAL is cleared; 1 START byte. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0.

fields.name: IC_TAR
fields.text: Target address of every master transfer; ignored for a General Call, and written once to make a START BYTE. With IC_TAR equal to IC_SAR the master and slave share the FIFOs, so only one-way (simplex) loopback works; a master can send only to a slave, not to itself. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0.

fields.name: IC_SAR
fields.text: Slave address used while the I2C runs as a slave; 7-bit addressing uses only IC_SAR[6:0]. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0 and are ignored otherwise.

fields.name: I2C_IC_HS_MAR
fields.text: This master's high-speed master code, 0 to 7. HS master codes are reserved 8-bit codes (00001xxx) not used for slave addresses; each master has its own, so up to eight HS masters can share a bus. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0 and are ignored otherwise.

fields.name: I2C_RESTART
fields.text: RESTART before this byte. 1: with IC_RESTART_EN at 1, a RESTART is always sent before the byte, direction change or not. 0: with IC_RESTART_EN at 1, a RESTART is sent only when the direction changes from the previous command. With IC_RESTART_EN at 0, a STOP then a START is sent in place of the RESTART in both cases.

fields.name: I2C_STOP
fields.text: STOP after this byte. 1: a STOP follows the byte whatever the TX FIFO holds; if the FIFO is not empty the master then sends a START and arbitrates for the bus again. 0: no STOP follows; if the FIFO is not empty the transfer continues per CMD, and if it is empty the master holds SCL low until a new command arrives.

fields.name: I2C_CMD
fields.text: Master transfer direction for this command: 1 read, 0 write; it has no effect on direction as a slave. Slave-receiver: don't care. Slave-transmitter: 0 sends the data in DAT. A read after a General Call raises TX_ABRT (bit 6 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT_REG) unless SPECIAL (I2C_TAR bit 11) was cleared; writing 1 after a RD_REQ interrupt raises TX_ABRT. If a RD_REQ arrives while a master read is being attempted, the write here is ignored, TX_ABRT is raised and the RD_REQ is served.

fields.name: I2C_DAT
fields.text: Byte sent or received on the bus. Ignored on a write that asks for a read; a read returns the byte received.

fields.name: IC_SS_SCL_HCNT
fields.text: SCL high-period count for standard speed; set before any bus transfer for correct I/O timing. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE is 0. Minimum 6: a smaller write sets 6. Must not exceed 65525, since a 16-bit counter flags bus idle at IC_SS_SCL_HCNT + 10.

fields.name: IC_SS_SCL_LCNT
fields.text: SCL low-period count for standard speed; set before any bus transfer for correct I/O timing. Writes take effect only while I2C_ENABLE is 0. Minimum 8: a smaller write sets 8.

fields.name: IC_FS_SCL_HCNT
fields.text: SCL high-period count for fast speed; in high-speed mode it also times the master code, START BYTE and General Call. Set before any bus transfer. Writes take effect only while I2C_ENABLE is 0. Minimum 6: a smaller write sets 6.

fields.name: IC_FS_SCL_LCNT
fields.text: SCL low-period count for fast speed; in high-speed mode it also times the master code, START BYTE and General Call. Set before any bus transfer. Writes take effect only while I2C_ENABLE is 0. Minimum 8: a smaller write sets 8. With APB_DATA_WIDTH = 8, write the lower byte first, then the upper byte.

fields.name: IC_HS_SCL_HCNT
fields.text: SCL high-period count for high speed; set before any bus transfer. SCL high time depends on bus load: 60 ns at 100 pF, 120 ns at 400 pF. Reads 0 and is read-only when IC_MAX_SPEED_MODE is not high. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0. Minimum 6: a smaller write sets 6. With APB_DATA_WIDTH = 8, write the lower byte first, then the upper byte.

fields.name: IC_HS_SCL_LCNT
fields.text: SCL low-period count for high speed; set before any bus transfer. SCL low time depends on bus load: 160 ns at 100 pF, 320 ns at 400 pF. Reads 0 and is read-only when IC_MAX_SPEED_MODE is not high. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0. Minimum 8: a smaller write sets 8. With APB_DATA_WIDTH = 8, write the lower byte first, then the upper byte.

fields.name: R_SCL_STUCK_AT_LOW
fields.text: SCL stuck at low interrupt status.

fields.name: R_MASTER_ON_HOLD
fields.text: Shows the master holding the bus with the TX FIFO empty. Needs both IC_EMPTYFIFO_HOLD_MASTER_EN=1 and I2C_DYNAMIC_TAR_UPDATE=1.

fields.name: R_RESTART_DET
fields.text: Shows a RESTART on the bus while in slave mode and addressed. Works only with IC_SLV_RESTART_DET_EN=1. In high-speed mode or a START BYTE transfer the RESTART precedes the address, so the slave is not yet addressed and no RESTART_DET is raised.

fields.name: R_GEN_CALL
fields.text: Set only when a General Call address arrives and is ACKed; the received data goes to the RX buffer. Cleared by disabling the controller or by the CPU reading bit 0 of I2C_CLR_GEN_CALL.

fields.name: R_START_DET
fields.text: Shows a START or RESTART on the bus, in slave or master mode.

fields.name: R_STOP_DET
fields.text: Shows a STOP on the bus, in slave or master mode.

fields.name: R_ACTIVITY
fields.text: Records bus activity and stays set, even once the controller is idle, until cleared by disabling the controller, reading IC_CLR_ACTIVITY, reading IC_CLR_INTR, or a system reset.

fields.name: R_RX_DONE
fields.text: As slave-transmitter, set to 1 when the master does not ACK a sent byte; this happens on the last byte and marks the end of the transfer.

fields.name: R_TX_ABRT
fields.text: Set when the controller, as master or slave transmitter, cannot finish what the TX FIFO holds (a transmit abort); I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE gives the cause. While set the TX FIFO is flushed, and it stays flushed until I2C_CLR_TX_ABRT is read; it then takes data from the APB again.

fields.name: R_RD_REQ
fields.text: Set to 1 when, as slave, a remote master asks to read data; SCL is held low until it is served. The processor then writes the data to I2C_DATA_CMD. Cleared just after the processor reads I2C_CLR_RD_REQ.

fields.name: R_TX_EMPTY
fields.text: Set to 1 when the TX buffer is at or below the I2C_TX_TL threshold; cleared by hardware once it rises above. With IC_ENABLE bit 0 at 0 the TX FIFO is emptied and kept in reset, so it looks empty: this bit is 1 while the master or slave state machine is active and 0 once activity ends.

fields.name: R_TX_OVER
fields.text: Set when the TX buffer holds 32 and the processor writes another command to IC_DATA_CMD. When the module is disabled it keeps its level until the state machines are idle, then clears as ic_en goes 0.

fields.name: R_RX_FULL
fields.text: Set when the RX buffer reaches or passes the RX_TL threshold in I2C_RX_TL; cleared by hardware once it falls below. Writing 0 to I2C_ENABLE bit 0 flushes the RX FIFO and holds it in reset, which clears this bit whatever activity continues.

fields.name: R_RX_OVER
fields.text: Set when the RX buffer holds 32 and another byte arrives from an external device; the byte is ACKed but lost. With I2C_ENABLE[0]=0 it keeps its level until the state machines are idle, then clears as ic_en goes 0.

fields.name: R_RX_UNDER
fields.text: Set when the processor reads IC_DATA_CMD with the RX buffer empty. With I2C_ENABLE[0]=0 it keeps its level until the state machines are idle, then clears as ic_en goes 0.

fields.name: M_SCL_STUCK_AT_LOW
fields.text: Mask for SCL_STUCK_AT_LOW; reserved.

fields.name: M_MASTER_ON_HOLD
fields.text: Masks MASTER_ON_HOLD in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_RESTART_DET
fields.text: Masks RESTART_DET in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_GEN_CALL
fields.text: Masks GEN_CALL in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_START_DET
fields.text: Masks START_DET in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_STOP_DET
fields.text: Masks STOP_DET in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_ACTIVITY
fields.text: Masks ACTIVITY in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_RX_DONE
fields.text: Masks RX_DONE in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_TX_ABRT
fields.text: Masks TX_ABRT in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_RD_REQ
fields.text: Masks RD_REQ in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_TX_EMPTY
fields.text: Masks TX_EMPTY in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_TX_OVER
fields.text: Masks TX_OVER in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_RX_FULL
fields.text: Masks RX_FULL in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_RX_OVER
fields.text: Masks RX_OVER in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: M_RX_UNDER
fields.text: Masks RX_UNDER in I2C_INTR_STAT.

fields.name: SCL_STUCK_AT_LOW
fields.text: SCL stuck low, raw status; reserved.

fields.name: MASTER_ON_HOLD
fields.text: Raw: master holding the bus with the TX FIFO empty. Needs both IC_EMPTYFIFO_HOLD_MASTER_EN=1 and I2C_DYNAMIC_TAR_UPDATE=1.

fields.name: RESTART_DET
fields.text: Raw: a RESTART on the bus while in slave mode and addressed. Works only with IC_SLV_RESTART_DET_EN=1. In high-speed mode or a START BYTE transfer the RESTART precedes the address, so the slave is not yet addressed and no RESTART_DET is raised.

fields.name: GEN_CALL
fields.text: Raw: set only when a General Call address arrives and is ACKed; the data goes to the RX buffer. Cleared by disabling the controller or by the CPU reading bit 0 of I2C_CLR_GEN_CALL.

fields.name: START_DET
fields.text: Raw: a START or RESTART on the bus, in slave or master mode.

fields.name: STOP_DET
fields.text: Raw: a STOP on the bus, in slave or master mode.

fields.name: ACTIVITY
fields.text: Raw: records bus activity and stays set, even once idle, until cleared by disabling the controller, reading IC_CLR_ACTIVITY, reading IC_CLR_INTR, or a system reset.

fields.name: RX_DONE
fields.text: Raw: as slave-transmitter, set to 1 when the master does not ACK a sent byte, which happens on the last byte and ends the transfer.

fields.name: TX_ABRT
fields.text: Raw: set when the controller, as master or slave transmitter, cannot finish what the TX FIFO holds (a transmit abort); I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE gives the cause. The TX FIFO is flushed while set and stays flushed until I2C_CLR_TX_ABRT is read.

fields.name: RD_REQ
fields.text: Raw: set to 1 when, as slave, a remote master asks to read; SCL is held low until served, and the processor then writes the data to I2C_DATA_CMD. Cleared just after the processor reads I2C_CLR_RD_REQ.

fields.name: TX_EMPTY
fields.text: Raw: 1 when the TX buffer is at or below the I2C_TX_TL threshold; cleared by hardware once above. With IC_ENABLE bit 0 at 0 the flushed FIFO looks empty, so this is 1 while a state machine is active and 0 once activity ends.

fields.name: TX_OVER
fields.text: Raw: set when the TX buffer holds 32 and another command is written to IC_DATA_CMD. When disabled it keeps its level until the state machines are idle, then clears as ic_en goes 0.

fields.name: RX_FULL
fields.text: Raw: set when the RX buffer reaches or passes RX_TL in I2C_RX_TL; cleared by hardware once below. Writing 0 to I2C_ENABLE bit 0 flushes the RX FIFO and clears this bit whatever activity continues.

fields.name: RX_OVER
fields.text: Raw: set when the RX buffer holds 32 and another byte arrives; the byte is ACKed but lost. With I2C_ENABLE[0]=0 it keeps its level until the state machines are idle, then clears as ic_en goes 0.

fields.name: RX_UNDER
fields.text: Raw: set when IC_DATA_CMD is read with the RX buffer empty. With I2C_ENABLE[0]=0 it keeps its level until the state machines are idle, then clears as ic_en goes 0.

fields.name: RX_TL
fields.text: RX FIFO threshold: the entry count at or above which RX_FULL (I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT bit 2) is raised. Range 0-31; 0 means 1 entry, 31 means 32. A value above the buffer depth is set to the depth.

fields.name: TX_TL
fields.text: TX FIFO threshold: the entry count at or below which TX_EMPTY (I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT bit 4) is raised. Range 0-31; 0 means 0 entries, 31 means 32. A value above the buffer depth is set to the depth.

fields.name: CLR_INTR
fields.text: A read clears the combined interrupt, every software-clearable interrupt and I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE; hardware-clearable interrupts are untouched. Bit 9 of I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE is an exception.

fields.name: CLR_RX_UNDER
fields.text: A read clears RX_UNDER (bit 0 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_RX_OVER
fields.text: A read clears RX_OVER (bit 1 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_TX_OVER
fields.text: A read clears TX_OVER (bit 3 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_RD_REQ
fields.text: A read clears RD_REQ (bit 5 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_TX_ABRT
fields.text: A read clears TX_ABRT (bit 6 of IC_RAW_INTR_STAT) and I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE, and lets the TX FIFO out of its flushed state to take writes again. Bit 9 of I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE is an exception.

fields.name: CLR_RX_DONE
fields.text: A read clears RX_DONE (bit 7 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_ACTIVITY
fields.text: A read clears ACTIVITY (bit 8 of IC_RAW_INTR_STAT) if the I2C is no longer active; while still active on the bus the bit stays set. Hardware clears it once the module is disabled and the bus is quiet. The value read gives the ACTIVITY status.

fields.name: CLR_STOP_DET
fields.text: A read clears STOP_DET (bit 9 of IC_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_START_DET
fields.text: A read clears START_DET (bit 10 of IC_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: CLR_GEN_CALL
fields.text: A read clears GEN_CALL (bit 11 of I2C_RAW_INTR_STAT).

fields.name: I2C_TX_CMD_BLOCK
fields.text: Master mode: 1 holds off transmission on the bus even with data in the TX FIFO; 0 starts transmission as soon as the first data is in the TX FIFO.

fields.name: I2C_ABORT
fields.text: Writing 1 aborts a master-mode transfer; accepted only while ENABLE is set, and software cannot clear it. The controller ends the current transfer, issues a STOP, flushes the TX FIFO and then raises TX_ABORT; the bit clears itself when the abort is done.

fields.name: I2C_EN
fields.text: Controller enable: 0 disabled, TX and RX FIFOs kept erased; 1 enabled. It may be disabled while active: both FIFOs are flushed, IC_INTR_STAT bits stay active until the controller is idle, a transmit stops after the current transfer and its buffer is cleared, and a receive stops after the current byte without ACK. Enabling or disabling takes two ic_clk cycles.

fields.name: LV_HOLD_RX_FIFO_FULL
fields.text: Slave bus hold because the RX FIFO is full and another byte has arrived: 1 holding for that reason; 0 not holding, or holding for another reason.

fields.name: SLV_HOLD_TX_FIFO_EMPTY
fields.text: Slave bus hold on a read request with the TX FIFO empty, kept until the FIFO has data: 1 holding for that reason; 0 not holding, or holding for another reason.

fields.name: MST_HOLD_RX_FIFO_FULL
fields.text: Master bus hold because the RX FIFO is full and another byte has arrived: 1 holding for that reason; 0 not holding, or holding for another reason.

fields.name: MST_HOLD_TX_FIFO_EMPTY
fields.text: Master bus hold in a write because the TX FIFO is empty and the last command sent had no Stop bit: 1 holding for that reason; 0 not holding, or holding for another reason.

fields.name: SLV_ACTIVITY
fields.text: Slave state machine activity: 1 the slave FSM is out of IDLE (slave side active); 0 it is in IDLE.

fields.name: MST_ACTIVITY
fields.text: Master state machine activity: 1 the master FSM is out of IDLE (master side active); 0 it is in IDLE.

fields.name: RFF
fields.text: Receive FIFO full: 1 every location is used; 0 at least one is free.

fields.name: RFNE
fields.text: Receive FIFO not empty: 1 it holds at least one entry; 0 it is empty.

fields.name: TFE
fields.text: Transmit FIFO empty: 1 it holds no valid entries; 0 it holds at least one. Raises no interrupt.

fields.name: TFNF
fields.text: Transmit FIFO not full: 1 at least one location is free; 0 it is full.

fields.name: I2C_ACTIVITY
fields.text: I2C activity status.

fields.name: TXFLR
fields.text: TX FIFO level: how many valid entries the TX FIFO holds.

fields.name: RXFLR
fields.text: RX FIFO level: how many valid entries the RX FIFO holds.

fields.name: I2C_SDA_RX_HOLD
fields.text: SDA hold time when receiving, in ic_clk periods.

fields.name: I2C_SDA_TX_HOLD
fields.text: SDA hold time when transmitting, in ic_clk periods.

fields.name: ABRT_USER_ABRT
fields.text: Master-transmitter only: the master saw a user abort (IC_ENABLE[1]).

fields.name: ABRT_SLVRD_INTX
fields.text: Slave-transmitter abort: 1 when, answering a remote master's request for data, a 1 was written to CMD (bit 8) of IC_DATA_CMD; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_SLV_ARBLOST
fields.text: Slave-transmitter abort: 1 the slave lost the bus while sending data to a remote master, with bit 12 set alongside; this is a fail-safe check, for example when the data line at an SCL rising edge differs from what was being sent. 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_SLVFLUSH_TXFIFO
fields.text: Slave-transmitter abort: 1 a read command arrived while old data was in the TX FIFO, so TX_ABRT was raised to flush it; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ARB_LOST
fields.text: Master- or slave-transmitter abort: 1 arbitration lost, by the master, or by the slave transmitter when bit 14 is also set (the controller may be master and slave at once); 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_MASTER_DIS
fields.text: Master abort: 1 a master operation was started while master mode was disabled; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_10B_RD_NORSTRT
fields.text: Master-receiver abort: 1 a read was sent in 10-bit addressing mode with RESTART disabled (IC_RESTART_EN, I2C_CON[5], at 0); 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_SBYTE_NORSTRT
fields.text: Master abort: 1 a START byte was attempted with RESTART disabled (I2C_CON[5] at 0); 0 not this case. It clears like the other bits only once its cause is removed (RESTART enabled, SPECIAL I2C_TAR[11] cleared, or GC_OR_START I2C_TAR[10] cleared); cleared earlier, it drops for one cycle and sets again.

fields.name: ABRT_HS_NORSTRT
fields.text: Master abort: 1 a high-speed transfer was attempted with RESTART disabled (I2C_CON[5] at 0); 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_SBYTE_ACKDET
fields.text: Master abort: 1 a START byte that was sent got an ACK, which is wrong behaviour; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_HS_ACKDET
fields.text: Master abort: 1 in high-speed mode the HS master code got an ACK, which is wrong behaviour; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_GCALL_READ
fields.text: Master-transmitter abort: 1 a General Call was sent and the next byte was programmed as a read (IC_DATA_CMD[9] at 1); 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_GCALL_NOACK
fields.text: Master-transmitter abort: 1 a General Call was sent and no slave ACKed it; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_TXDATA_NOACK
fields.text: Master-transmitter abort (master mode only): 1 the address was ACKed but data bytes after it were not; 0 not this case.

fields.name: ABRT_10ADDR2_NOACK
fields.text: Master abort in 10-bit address mode: 1 no slave ACKed the second address byte; 0 no such abort.

fields.name: ABRT_10ADDR1_NOACK
fields.text: Master abort in 10-bit address mode: 1 no slave ACKed the first address byte; 0 no such abort.

fields.name: ABRT_7B_ADDR_NOACK
fields.text: Master abort in 7-bit address mode: 1 no slave ACKed the address; 0 no such abort.

fields.name: TDMAE
fields.text: Transmit FIFO DMA channel: 0 disabled, 1 enabled.

fields.name: RDMAE
fields.text: Receive FIFO DMA channel: 0 disabled, 1 enabled.

fields.name: DMATDL
fields.text: Transmit data level: the TX watermark. With TDMAE = 1, dma_tx_req is raised when the TX FIFO holds this many valid entries or fewer.

fields.name: DMARDL
fields.text: Receive data level: the RX watermark is DMARDL+1. With RDMAE = 1, dma_rx_req is raised when the RX FIFO holds DMARDL+1 valid entries or more; at 0, one entry is enough.

fields.name: SDA_SETUP
fields.text: SDA setup: as slave-transmitter serving a read request, the delay in I2C clock periods, made by holding SCL low, between the SCL rising edge and SDA changing; this meets tSU:DAT of the I2C bus. Must be 2 or more; for a 1000 ns delay at a 10 MHz I2C clock the value is 11. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] = 0.

fields.name: ACK_GEN_CALL
fields.text: Reply to a General Call: 1 ACK (ic_data_oe asserted); 0 NACK, and no General Call interrupts.

fields.name: SLV_RX_DATA_LOST
fields.text: 1 a slave-receive transfer with a matching address was cut off by IC_ENABLE going 1 to 0 after its data phase began, even if the byte was NACKed; also set if the remote master ends with STOP before the NACK and IC_ENABLE is 0. 0 disabled without taking part in a slave-receive data phase. Reliable to read once IC_EN (bit 0) reads 0.

fields.name: SLV_DISABLED_WHILE_BUSY
fields.text: 1 a possible or active slave operation was cut off by writing 0 to IC_ENABLE while receiving the address byte of a slave-transmit, or address and data of a slave-receive; the controller forced a NACK whether or not the address matched IC_SAR, or the transfer finished before the disable took effect; also set if the remote master ends with STOP before the NACK and IC_ENABLE is 0. 0 disabled during master activity or an idle bus. Reliable to read once IC_EN (bit 0) reads 0.

fields.name: IC_EN
fields.text: Follows the ic_en output: 1 controller enabled; 0 fully inactive. Readable at any time; when 0, SLV_RX_DATA_LOST and SLV_DISABLED_WHILE_BUSY may be read.

fields.name: I2C_FS_SPKLEN
fields.text: Longest spike on SCL or SDA, in ic_clk cycles, that the spike filter removes; set before any bus transfer. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE is 0. Minimum 1: a smaller write sets 1.

fields.name: I2C_HS_SPKLEN
fields.text: Longest spike on SCL or SDA, in ic_clk cycles, that the spike filter removes; set before any bus transfer. Writes take effect only while IC_ENABLE[0] is 0. Minimum 1: a smaller write sets 1.

fields.name: PDC_MASTER
fields.text: Master woken by this entry: 0x0 entry disabled; 0x1 PD_SYS powered and CM33 triggered; 0x2 PD_RAD powered and CMAC triggered; 0x3 PD_COM powered and SNC triggered.

fields.name: EN_COM
fields.text: 1 turns on PD_COM for GPIO access; implied when PDC_MASTER is SNC.

fields.name: EN_PER
fields.text: 1 turns on PD_PER.

fields.name: EN_TMR
fields.text: 1 turns on PD_TMR.

fields.name: EN_XTAL
fields.text: 1 starts the XTAL32M.

fields.name: TRIG_ID
fields.text: Bit within the chosen bank that acts as the wakeup source; for the peripheral banks (TRIG_SELECT 0x2 or 0x3) only the low 4 bits count.

fields.name: TRIG_SELECT
fields.text: Wake-up trigger bank: 0x0 GPIO port 0 via the WAKEUP block; 0x1 GPIO port 1 via the WAKEUP block; 0x2 or 0x3 a peripheral IRQ, numbered 0x0 Timer, 0x1 Timer2, 0x2 Timer3, 0x3 Timer4, 0x4 RTC alarm or rollover, 0x5 the RTC timer, 0x6 the CMAC timer or a CMAC debugger wake-up, 0x7 the motor controller, 0x8 XTAL32MRDY_IRQ, 0x9 RFDIAG_IRQ, 0xA CMAC2SYS_IRQ, VBUS present, JTAG present or a debounced IO, 0xB the sensor node controller, 0xC-0xE reserved, 0xF a software trigger alone.

fields.text: 1 turns on PD_COM for GPIO access; implied when PDC_MASTER is SNC.

fields.name: EN_PER
fields.text: 1 turns on PD_PER.

fields.name: EN_TMR
fields.text: 1 turns on PD_TMR.

fields.name: EN_XTAL
fields.text: 1 starts the XTAL32M.

fields.name: TRIG_ID
fields.text: Bit within the bank chosen by TRIG_SELECT that acts as the wakeup source; for the peripheral banks (TRIG_SELECT 0x2 or 0x3) only the low 4 bits count.

fields.name: TRIG_SELECT
fields.text: Wake-up trigger bank: 0x0 GPIO port 0 via the WAKEUP block; 0x1 GPIO port 1 via the WAKEUP block; 0x2 or 0x3 a peripheral IRQ, numbered 0x0 Timer, 0x1 Timer2, 0x2 Timer3, 0x3 Timer4, 0x4 RTC alarm or rollover, 0x5 the RTC timer, 0x6 the CMAC timer or a CMAC debugger wake-up, 0x7 the motor controller, 0x8 XTAL32MRDY_IRQ, 0x9 RFDIAG_IRQ, 0xA CMAC2SYS_IRQ, VBUS present, JTAG present or a debounced IO, 0xB the sensor node controller, 0xC-0xE reserved, 0xF a software trigger alone.

fields.name: PDC_ACKNOWLEDGE
fields.text: A write acknowledges a PDC IRQ request; the value written picks which request.

fields.name: PDC_PENDING
fields.text: One bit per IRQ id that is pending.

fields.name: PDC_PENDING
fields.text: One bit per IRQ id pending toward the Sensor Node Controller.

fields.name: PDC_PENDING
fields.text: One bit per IRQ id pending toward the CM33.

fields.name: PDC_PENDING
fields.text: One bit per IRQ id pending toward the CMAC.

fields.name: PDC_SET_PENDING
fields.text: A write sets a PDC wakeup request and IRQ; the value written picks which request.

fields.name: DCDC_SH_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the sample-and-hold circuit of the output comparators.

fields.name: DCDC_STARTUP_DELAY
fields.text: Time from bias switch-on until the converter goes active: 0 to 31 us in 1 us steps.

fields.name: DCDC_IDLE_MAX_FAST_DOWNRAMP
fields.text: Longest output idle time for the fast ramp-down of the current limit: 0 to 7875 ns in 125 ns steps.

fields.name: DCDC_SW_TIMEOUT
fields.text: Timeout for the P and N switches: a switch held closed past it raises a timeout and moves the FSM to its next state. 62.5 to 1937.5 ns in 62.5 ns steps; 0 turns the timeout off.

fields.name: DCDC_FAST_STARTUP
fields.text: Holds the current limit at its maximum through the first startup.

fields.name: DCDC_MAN_LV_MODE
fields.text: Turns on the low-voltage settings by hand.

fields.name: DCDC_AUTO_LV_MODE
fields.text: Moves to the low-voltage settings once the battery voltage falls under 2.5 V.

fields.name: DCDC_IDLE_CLK_DIV
fields.text: Divider of the idle clock. 00: 2. 01: 4. 10: 8. 11: 16.

fields.name: DCDC_PRIORITY
fields.text: Charge priority: four 2-bit output IDs, charged in the order [1:0], [3:2], [5:4], [7:6]. IDs: 00 V14, 01 V18, 10 VDD, 11 V18P.

fields.name: DCDC_FW_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the freewheel switch.

fields.name: DCDC_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns the DCDC converter on.

fields.name: DCDC_V_NOK_CNT_MAX
fields.text: Count of V_NOK events an output may see before its V_AVAILABLE is cleared.

fields.name: DCDC_N_COMP_TRIM_MAN
fields.text: Selects manual trim for the N-side comparator.

fields.name: DCDC_N_COMP_TRIM_VAL

fields.name: DCDC_TIMEOUT_IRQ_TRIG

fields.name: DCDC_TIMEOUT_IRQ_RES

fields.name: DCDC_SLOPE_CONTROL

fields.name: DCDC_VBTSTRP_TRIM
fields.text: Bootstrap voltage trim: V = 1.6 V + N x 100 mV.

fields.name: DCDC_LSSUP_TRIM

fields.name: DCDC_HSGND_TRIM

fields.name: DCDC_V14_TRIM

fields.name: DMA0_A_START
fields.text: Start address of the source.

fields.name: DMA0_B_START
fields.text: Start address of the destination.

fields.name: DMA0_INT
fields.text: Transfer count at which the channel interrupts: the interrupt fires after a transfer when this value matches DMAx_IDX_REG, ahead of the DMAx_IDX_REG increment. DMA_INT_MASK_REG.DMA_IRQ_ENABLEx must be 1 for the interrupt to be raised.

fields.name: DMA0_LEN
fields.text: Transfer length of the channel minus one: 0 moves 1 item, 1 moves 2, and so on.

fields.name: BUS_ERROR_DETECT
fields.text: Bus error tracking. 0: an AHB bus error response is ignored and the transfer carries on. 1: bus errors are watched for during the transfer; on one, the channel finishes its current read-write cycle (burst or single), ends the transfer and clears DMA_ON by itself. The channel's bus error flag in DMA_INT_STATUS_REG clears when the channel is turned on again for a new transfer.

fields.name: BURST_MODE
fields.text: Read/write bursts. 00: no bursts. 01: bursts of 4. 10: bursts of 8. 11: reserved.

fields.name: REQ_SENSE
fields.text: Kind of peripheral request the channel answers. 0: level-sensitive (default). 1: rising-edge-sensitive.

fields.name: DMA_INIT
fields.text: Memory fill mode. 0: copies A1 to B1, A2 to B2 and so on. 1: copies A1 to B1, B2 and onward, fetching from A only once, so a block of memory can be set to one value; BINC must be 1 and AINC is ignored. The fill cannot be interrupted by other channels. Not to be used with DREQ_MODE = 1.

fields.name: DMA_IDLE
fields.text: Bus sharing. 0: blocking, a fast back-to-back copy that keeps every lower-priority bus master off the bus. 1: interrupting, a wait cycle after each store lets the CPU take cycles or the cache do a burst read. Ignored when DREQ_MODE = 1.

values.text: Blocking: back-to-back copy that shuts out lower-priority bus masters.
Interrupting: a wait cycle follows each store, leaving cycles for the CPU or a cache burst read. Ignored when DREQ_MODE = 1.

fields.name: DMA_PRIO
fields.text: Channel priority for the bus when several active channels ask at once; a higher value wins, 000 lowest and 111 highest. Between equal levels the lower-numbered channel goes first (DMA0 before DMA1).

fields.name: CIRCULAR
fields.text: 0: normal; the channel stops once the length in DMAx_LEN_REG is done and DMA_ON clears. 1: circular, only with DREQ_MODE = 1; DMA_ON stays set and the channel resets DMAx_IDX_REG and starts again by itself.

values.text: Normal: the channel stops after DMAx_LEN_REG items and DMA_ON clears.
Circular, only with DREQ_MODE = 1: DMA_ON stays set and the channel resets DMAx_IDX_REG and starts again.

fields.name: AINC
fields.text: Steps the source address after each transfer. 0: the address stays fixed for the whole transfer. 1: it grows by the width set in BW: 1 for BW = 00, 2 for BW = 01, 4 for BW = 10.

fields.name: BINC
fields.text: Steps the destination address after each transfer. 0: the address stays fixed for the whole transfer. 1: it grows by the width set in BW: 1 for BW = 00, 2 for BW = 01, 4 for BW = 10.

fields.name: DREQ_MODE
fields.text: Start condition. 0: the channel starts at once. 1: the channel waits for a peripheral DMA request, routed by DMA_REQ_MUX_REG.

values.text: Waits for a peripheral DMA request, routed by DMA_REQ_MUX_REG.

fields.name: BW
fields.text: Width of each bus transfer. 00: 1 byte, the suggested width for UART and 8-bit SPI. 01: 2 bytes, the suggested width for I2C and 16-bit SPI. 10: 4 bytes, the suggested width for copies from memory into memory. 11: reserved.

fields.name: DMA_ON
fields.text: Channel on. 0: off, clocks stopped. 1: on; cleared by hardware when a transfer completes unless circular mode is on, where it stays set. If software clears it mid-transfer, the channel finishes its current read-write cycle before stopping, and DMA_ON cannot be set again until a read of it returns 0.

fields.name: DMA0_IDX
fields.text: Read-only count of items the channel has finished moving; while it reads N the channel is working on item N+1. When a non-circular transfer ends (DMA_ON cleared) it holds its last value, normally DMAx_LEN_REG, and returns to 0 when a new transfer starts. In CIRCULAR mode it returns to 0 each time the channel starts over.

fields.name: DMA01_SEL
