fields.text: Interrupt enable of channel 0. 0: off. 1: on.

fields.name: EOC_INTERVAL_CHECK_TIMER
fields.text: Present count of the timer that paces End-of-Charge sampling while the FSM is in CC_CHARGE or CV_CHARGE; held at 0 in other states. Once in CC_CHARGE it starts on a rising End-of-Charge edge and counts toward EOC_INTERVAL_CHECK_THRES; a falling edge before then clears it to wait for the next rising edge. It also clears on reaching the threshold, or when END_OF_CHARGE is the FSM's next state, which follows 4 consecutive high samples with no drop inside an interval. Clocked at the charger's 1 MHz; value runs 0 to EOC_INTERVAL_CHECK_THRES.

fields.name: EOC_INTERVAL_CHECK_THRES
fields.text: Interval between End-of-Charge samples in CC_CHARGE and CV_CHARGE: the count EOC_INTERVAL_CHECK_TIMER climbs to from 0. Each time it is reached, End-of-Charge is sampled and, if high, the consecutive-event counter (CHARGER_STATUS_REG.EOC_EVENTS_DEBOUNCE_CNT) steps up. Must be non-zero.

fields.name: REPLENISH_MODE
fields.text: In the BYPASSED state (Bypass mode), 1 makes the charger's digital multiplexer feed the Replenish level, not the Pre-charge level, to the main Vbat comparator; software can then read CHARGER_STATUS_REG.MAIN_VBAT_COMP_OUT once the battery has reached End-of-Charge to learn whether Vbat has fallen under Replenish and restart charging. Ignored while the FSM runs: the FSM then picks Pre-charge or Replenish by its state. The levels live in CHARGER_VOLTAGE_PARAM_REG.

fields.name: PRE_CHARGE_MODE
fields.text: Drives the PRE_CHARGE_MODE signal from the charger's digital part to its analogue part, selecting the Pre-Charge current. Used only in the BYPASSED state (Bypass mode); ignored while the FSM runs. With the FSM bypassed, software sets it during the Pre-Charge phase to supply Pre-Charge rather than normal charge current. Current levels are in CHARGER_CURRENT_PARAM_REG.

fields.name: CHARGE_LOOP_HOLD
fields.text: 1 stops charging once the FSM is in the BYPASSED state (reached by setting CHARGER_BYPASS); in that state this bit replaces the FSM's own signal so the analogue part stays controllable. Ignored when the FSM is not bypassed.

fields.name: JEITA_SUPPORT_DISABLED
fields.text: 0: the JEITA FSM also tests for the Warm and Cool battery zones and, by the zone the analogue part finds, adjusts every voltage level in CHARGER_VOLTAGE_PARAM_REG (Charge, Pre-Charge, Replenish, OVP) and the charge and pre-charge currents in CHARGER_CURRENT_PARAM_REG. 1: it tests only for Hot and Cold and tells the main FSM to stop charging in Hot, and in Cold too unless NTC_LOW_DISABLE is set. Leaving this at 0 while TBAT_PROT_ENABLE is also 0 is advised against; JEITA support goes with battery temperature protection.

fields.name: TBAT_MONITOR_MODE
fields.text: Battery temperature monitoring mode. 00: the state is checked once, when the charger has powered up and settled. 01: checked every TBAT_MON_TIMER_REG.TBAT_MON_INTERVAL while the charger is powered up and its FSM enabled. 10: checked every TBAT_MON_INTERVAL while the charger is powered up, whether or not its FSM is enabled, so independent of CHARGE_START. 11: the monitor FSM stops once it reaches CHECK_IDLE, and software follows battery temperature by reading MAIN_TBAT_COMP_OUT plus TBAT_HOT_COMP_OUT in CHARGER_STATUS_REG; usable with CHARGER_BYPASS so that software runs both charging and temperature monitoring.

fields.name: CHARGE_TIMERS_HALT_ENABLE
fields.text: 0: the charge timeout timers keep counting while a die or battery temperature error has disabled charging. 1: on such an error they stop: the global charge timer halts when the FSM enters TDIE_PROT or TBAT_PROT, as does whichever of the Pre-Charge, CC_CHARGE or CV_CHARGE timers belongs to the state the FSM was in.

fields.name: NTC_LOW_DISABLE
fields.text: 0: a battery in the COLD region stops charging; the FSM goes straight to TBAT_PROT, the TBAT_ERROR_IRQ flag of CHARGER_ERROR_IRQ_STATUS_REG is updated, and an IRQ is raised if its bit in CHARGER_ERROR_IRQ_MASK_REG is set. 1: charging goes on in the COLD region and no battery temperature error is raised.

fields.name: TBAT_PROT_ENABLE
fields.text: Battery temperature protection. 0: off. 1: on; charging stops when the battery reaches the Hot zone, and the Cold zone too unless CHARGER_CTRL_REG.NTC_LOW_DISABLE is set. The FSM enters TBAT_PROT and raises an error IRQ if its bit in CHARGER_ERROR_IRQ_MASK_REG is set.

fields.name: TDIE_ERROR_RESUME
fields.text: 0: the FSM does not leave a die temperature error; it remains in TDIE_PROT while this bit is 0, whatever the die temperature comparator shows, and clearing the bit in TDIE_PROT resets the die temperature error debounce counter (CHARGER_STATUS_REG.TDIE_ERROR_DEBOUNCE_CNT), which holds at 0 until the bit is set. 1: the FSM leaves the error once the analogue comparator shows the die back below the maximum, which is set by CHARGER_TEMPSET_PARAM_REG.TDIE_MAX.

fields.name: TDIE_PROT_ENABLE
fields.text: Die temperature protection. 0: off; a die temperature error does not stop charging. 1: on; on a die temperature error the FSM enters TDIE_PROT and charging stops. The event is recorded in its status bit, and an IRQ follows only if its mask bit is set.

fields.name: CHARGER_RESUME
fields.text: 0: the FSM does not recover from a charge timeout or a Vbat over-voltage (OVP) error and remains in ERROR. 1: after such an error the FSM goes from ERROR to DISABLED and the charge cycle begins again; after an OVP error it leaves ERROR only once the OVP comparator shows Vbat back below the OVP level.

fields.name: CHARGER_BYPASS
fields.text: Charger FSM bypass.

values.text: FSM active, reporting each change of state to software.
FSM bypassed and held in BYPASS; software must watch the battery voltage and run the charger.

fields.name: CHARGE_START
fields.text: Charger FSM enable.

values.text: FSM enabled: it may leave DISABLED for the charge states, beginning with PRE_CHARGE.

fields.name: CHARGER_ENABLE
fields.text: 0: the charger's analogue part is powered down. 1: it powers up and is ready after a settling time in ms, set in CHARGER_PWR_UP_TIMER_REG and counted on the 1 kHz clock; the FSM waits that time, then enters DISABLED, where it checks Vbat, die temperature and battery temperature, which must happen before it moves to PRE_CHARGE. CLK_SYS_REG[CLK_CHG_EN] must first be 1 to enable the charger clocks, or the FSM does not proceed.

fields.name: OVP_EVENTS_DEBOUNCE_CNT
fields.text: Count of consecutive samples with Vbat above the Over-Voltage Protection level. The FSM leaves PRE/CC/CV_CHARGE for ERROR when it reaches or passes 4, the same debounce scheme used for End-of-Charge and for die temperature. It counts only in those three charge states, when the Vbat OVP interval timer has reached its threshold and the OVP comparator output is high. Normally it runs 0 to 4 and clears on entering ERROR. If the OVP comparator is checked less often than 5 times CHARGER_VOVP_COMP_TIMER_REG[OVP_INTERVAL_CHECK_THRES] while Vbat is over the level, it can pass 4 and overflow; detection is unaffected, and the FSM goes to ERROR once the count is 4 or more (bit 2 set) and the OVP comparator timer has expired. Debounce timing: OVP_INTERVAL_CHECK_TIMER and OVP_INTERVAL_CHECK_THRES in CHARGER_VOVP_COMP_TIMER_REG.

fields.name: EOC_EVENTS_DEBOUNCE_CNT
fields.text: Count of consecutive high samples of the End-of-Charge signal from the analogue circuit; this debounce decides when CV_CHARGE gives way to END_OF_CHARGE. Clocked at 1 MHz. Steps up when End-of-Charge is high as the check interval expires (the interval timer only starts after a rising edge). Clears when End-of-Charge is low at expiry or falls before expiry, then starts over. Does not step if End-of-Charge is high but CV_MODE, or End-of-Charge on the previous clock, is low. Clears outside CC_CHARGE and CV_CHARGE, and after reaching 4 (100b), the count at which End-of-Charge is taken as stable and END_OF_CHARGE is entered; so it runs 0 to 4. Interval set by CHARGER_CTRL_REG.EOC_INTERVAL_CHECK_TIMER/THRES.

fields.name: TDIE_ERROR_DEBOUNCE_CNT
fields.text: Count of consecutive die temperature comparator readings above the set level (error) or below it (recovery). It steps up on each reading above the level while charging with CHARGER_CTRL_REG.TDIE_PROT_ENABLE set (with that bit clear it is reset and held at 0), and on each reading below the level while in TDIE_PROT with CHARGER_CTRL_REG.TDIE_ERROR_RESUME set (with that bit clear it is reset and held at 0 until resume is enabled again). Four readings above while charging is a die temperature error: the FSM enters TDIE_PROT, stops charging and clears the count. Four readings below, with TDIE_ERROR_RESUME set, clears it again and the FSM resumes at PRE_CHARGE. So it runs 0 to 4. In BYPASSED it is reset and held at 0; software must count over-temperature readings itself.

fields.name: CHARGER_JEITA_STATE
fields.text: State of the JEITA FSM, which updates the battery temperature state according to CHARGER_CTRL_REG.TBAT_MONITOR_MODE. States: 0x0 idle (CHECK_IDLE); 0x1 Hot test (CHECK_THOT); 0x2 Cold test (CHECK_TCOLD); 0x3 Warm test (CHECK_TWARM); 0x4 Cool test (CHECK_TCOOL); 0x5 Normal test (CHECK_TNORMAL); 0x6 status update (UPDATE_TBAT). Starting from CHECK_IDLE, the FSM tests the Hot, Cold, Warm, Cool and Normal zones in turn; on finding the zone it goes to UPDATE_TBAT, updates the battery temperature state, informs the main FSM, and returns to CHECK_IDLE. Each refresh raises a Charger State IRQ (CHARGER_STATE_IRQ_MASK_REG).

fields.name: CHARGER_STATE
fields.text: State of the charger's main FSM. 0x0: POWER_UP, charger power-up not set. 0x1: INIT, powering up, waiting for the analogue part to settle. 0x2: DISABLED, powered up, charging not started. 0x3: PRE_CHARGE. 0x4: CC_CHARGE, constant current. 0x5: CV_CHARGE, constant voltage. 0x6: END_OF_CHARGE. 0x7: TDIE_PROT, die temperature limit exceeded. 0x8: TBAT_PROT, battery temperature COLD or HOT. 0x9: BYPASSED, FSM bypassed with software in control. 0xA: ERROR, after a charge timeout or Vbat above the over-voltage level.

fields.name: TBAT_STATUS
fields.text: Battery temperature zone, one-hot: 0x1 COLD (default), 0x2 COOL, 0x4 NORMAL (between COOL and WARM), 0x8 WARM, 0x10 HOT. Only these values occur; one bit at most is set. Under JEITA (CHARGER_CTRL_REG.JEITA_SUPPORT_DISABLED clear), charging always stops in HOT, and in COLD too unless CHARGER_CTRL_REG.NTC_LOW_DISABLE is set, in which case it goes on.

fields.name: MAIN_TBAT_COMP_OUT
fields.text: Output of the main battery temperature comparator. It tests for the Cold zone by default; with JEITA enabled and the battery in neither Hot nor Cold, it is reused for the Warm and Cool zones. Meant for bypass mode with JEITA disabled, when it compares against the Cold level: 0: battery below the Cold level, in the Cold zone, and charging is disabled unless CHARGER_CTRL_REG.NTC_LOW_DISABLE is set. 1: battery above the Cold zone, and charging continues provided it is not in the Hot zone. With the main FSM active and JEITA enabled, the charger's digital block controls this comparator's output.

fields.name: TBAT_HOT_COMP_OUT
fields.text: Output of the Hot-zone battery temperature comparator. 0: battery below the Hot zone. 1: battery in the Hot zone; charging is disabled if battery temperature protection is on.

fields.name: TDIE_COMP_OUT
fields.text: 0: die temperature below the level in CHARGER_TEMPSET_PARAM_REG.TDIE_MAX, normal operation. 1: die above that level. With die temperature protection on, four readings above it in a row (TDIE_ERROR_DEBOUNCE_CNT) stop charging, move the FSM to TDIE_PROT, and raise an IRQ if its bit in CHARGER_ERROR_IRQ_MASK_REG is set.

fields.name: VBAT_OVP_COMP_OUT
fields.text: Over-voltage protection comparator output. 0: Vbat not above the OVP limit. 1: Vbat above the OVP setting; charging should be disabled. The OVP level is CHARGER_VOLTAGE_PARAM_REG.V_OVP in the Normal zone and CHARGER_JEITA_V_OVP_REG in the Cool and Warm zones.

fields.name: MAIN_VBAT_COMP_OUT
fields.text: Output of the main Vbat comparator in the charger's analogue part, which compares Vbat with the Pre-Charge or the Replenish level as the digital block chooses: Replenish once the active FSM has reached END_OF_CHARGE, Pre-Charge otherwise, bypass mode included. Against Pre-Charge: 0: Vbat below the level. 1: Vbat at or above it. Against Replenish, after charging completes: 0: Vbat below the level; charging restarts and the FSM goes to PRE_CHARGE. 1: Vbat at or above it; charging stays on hold and the FSM stays in END_OF_CHARGE.

fields.name: END_OF_CHARGE
fields.text: End of charge flag.

values.text: Charge current above CHARGER_CURRENT_PARAM_REG.I_END_OF_CHARGE, or charger off.

fields.name: CHARGER_CV_MODE
fields.text: Constant voltage mode flag.

values.text: Voltage loop out of regulation, or charger off.

fields.name: CHARGER_CC_MODE
fields.text: Constant current mode flag.

values.text: Current loop out of regulation, or charger off.

fields.name: CHARGER_IS_POWERED_UP
fields.text: Charger powered-up flag.

values.text: Charger off, or powering on with the analogue part not yet settled; main FSM in POWER_UP or INIT.
Charger powered up, analogue part settled; the FSM has left POWER_UP and INIT and charging may begin.

fields.name: V_OVP
fields.text: VBAT over-voltage protection level, used by a dedicated analogue comparator whose output the digital block samples. When VBAT reaches or passes it, the FSM goes to ERROR and charging stops; an Error IRQ pulse follows if its mask bit is set. Coded as V_CHARGE.

fields.name: V_REPLENISH
fields.text: Replenish voltage threshold. Once charging is done and the FSM is in END_OF_CHARGE, an analogue comparator checks VBAT against it; if VBAT falls below, charging restarts and the FSM returns to PRE_CHARGE. Coded as V_CHARGE.

fields.name: V_PRECHARGE
fields.text: Voltage at which the battery counts as pre-charged and the FSM moves to CC_CHARGE for constant-current charging. Coded as V_CHARGE.

fields.name: V_CHARGE
fields.text: Charge voltage. 0 to 20: 2.80 V to 3.80 V in 0.05 V steps. 21 to 60: 3.82 V to 4.60 V in 0.02 V steps. 61: 4.70 V. 62: 4.80 V. 63: 4.90 V, not supported here or in V_PRECHARGE and V_REPLENISH; it is for V_OVP alone, as the highest over-voltage level. These levels hold for the Normal battery zone; the JEITA FSM, checking battery temperature once or periodically (CHARGER_CTRL_REG.TBAT_MONITOR_MODE), may rewrite this field and the register's other three to suit the zone, and the register then reads back the JEITA settings for COOL, WARM or NORMAL.

fields.name: I_EOC_DOUBLE_RANGE
fields.text: 1 widens the End-of-Charge current range: the I_END_OF_CHARGE span of 4% (code 0x0) to 16% (code 0x7) of I_CHARGE becomes 8.8% to 35.2%.

fields.name: I_PRECHARGE
fields.text: Pre-charge current, 0.5 mA to 56 mA. 0 to 15: 0.5 mA to 8 mA in 0.5 mA steps. 16 to 31: 9 mA to 24 mA in 1 mA steps. 32 to 47: 26 mA to 56 mA in 2 mA steps. 48 to 63: 56 mA.

fields.name: I_CHARGE
fields.text: Charge current, 5 mA to 560 mA. 0 to 15: 5 mA to 80 mA in 5 mA steps. 16 to 31: 90 mA to 240 mA in 10 mA steps. 32 to 47: 260 mA to 560 mA in 20 mA steps. 48 to 63: 560 mA. These hold for the Normal battery zone; with JEITA support enabled in CHARGER_CTRL_REG, the JEITA FSM, checking battery temperature once or periodically (CHARGER_CTRL_REG.TBAT_MONITOR_MODE), may rewrite this field and I_PRECHARGE for the new zone, and the register then reads back the JEITA settings for COOL, WARM or NORMAL.

fields.name: TDIE_MAX
fields.text: Highest allowed die temperature. 000: 0 C, mainly for test. 001: 50 C. 010: 80 C. 011: 90 C. 100: 100 C. 101: 110 C. 110: 120 C. 111: 130 C.

fields.name: TBAT_HOT
fields.text: Battery temperature above which charge current is zero, marking the Hot zone; -10 C to 53 C, coded as TBAT_COLD.

fields.name: TBAT_WARM
fields.text: Battery temperature above which charge current is cut back, marking the Warm zone; -10 C to 53 C, coded as TBAT_COLD.

fields.name: TBAT_COOL
fields.text: Battery temperature below which charge current is cut back, marking the Cool zone; -10 C to 53 C, coded as TBAT_COLD.

fields.name: TBAT_COLD
fields.text: Battery temperature under which charge current is zero, the edge of the Cold zone: code n gives (n - 10) C, from 0 for -10 C to 63 for 53 C in 1 C steps.

fields.name: PRE_CHARGE_TIMER
fields.text: Present value of the Pre-Charge timeout counter, on a 1 Hz clock. Same span as the CC-Charge and CV-Charge timers: up to 6 hours, counting 0 to MAX_PRE_CHARGE_TIME. Cleared in the DISABLED and END_OF_CHARGE states.

fields.name: MAX_PRE_CHARGE_TIME
fields.text: Longest Pre-Charge stage allowed, in ticks of the charger's 1 Hz clock. Overrunning it is a Pre-Charge timeout error and the FSM enters ERROR; setting CHARGER_CTRL_REG.CHARGER_RESUME leaves it and restarts charging. Must be non-zero.

fields.name: CC_CHARGE_TIMER
fields.text: Present value of the CC-Charge timeout counter, on a 1 Hz clock. Same span as the Pre-Charge and CV-Charge timers: up to 6 hours, counting 0 to MAX_CC_CHARGE_TIME. Cleared in the DISABLED and END_OF_CHARGE states.

fields.name: MAX_CC_CHARGE_TIME
fields.text: Longest Constant Current stage allowed, in ticks of the charger's 1 Hz clock. Overrunning it is a CC timeout error and the FSM enters ERROR; setting CHARGER_CTRL_REG.CHARGER_RESUME leaves it and restarts charging. Must be non-zero.

fields.name: CV_CHARGE_TIMER
fields.text: Present value of the CV-Charge timeout counter, on a 1 Hz clock. Same span as the Pre-Charge and CC-Charge timers: up to 6 hours, counting 0 to MAX_CV_CHARGE_TIME. Cleared in the DISABLED and END_OF_CHARGE states.

fields.name: MAX_CV_CHARGE_TIME
fields.text: Longest Constant Voltage stage allowed, in ticks of the charger's 1 Hz clock. Overrunning it is a CV timeout error and the FSM enters ERROR; setting CHARGER_CTRL_REG.CHARGER_RESUME leaves it and restarts charging. Must be non-zero.

fields.name: TOTAL_CHARGE_TIMER
fields.text: Present value of the overall charge timeout counter, on a 1 Hz clock. 16 bits wide, so up to 10.5 hours, counting 0 to MAX_TOTAL_CHARGE_TIME. Cleared in the DISABLED and END_OF_CHARGE states.

fields.name: MAX_TOTAL_CHARGE_TIME
fields.text: Longest overall charge allowed, in ticks of the 1 Hz clock. Overrunning it is a total charge timeout error: the FSM enters ERROR, and an IRQ is raised if its CHARGER_ERROR_IRQ_MASK_REG bit was set beforehand. Setting CHARGER_CTRL_REG.CHARGER_RESUME moves the FSM from ERROR to DISABLED to start again. Must be non-zero.

fields.name: V_CHARGE_TWARM
fields.text: Charge voltage in the Warm battery zone; coded as CHARGER_VOLTAGE_PARAM_REG.V_CHARGE.

fields.name: V_CHARGE_TCOOL
fields.text: Charge voltage in the Cool battery zone; coded as CHARGER_VOLTAGE_PARAM_REG.V_CHARGE.

fields.name: V_PRECHARGE_TWARM
fields.text: Pre-Charge voltage in the Warm battery zone; coded as CHARGER_VOLTAGE_PARAM_REG.V_CHARGE.

fields.name: V_PRECHARGE_TCOOL
fields.text: Pre-Charge setting in the Cool battery zone; coded as CHARGER_VOLTAGE_PARAM_REG.V_CHARGE.

fields.name: V_REPLENISH_TWARM
fields.text: Replenish voltage in the Warm battery zone; coded as CHARGER_VOLTAGE_PARAM_REG.V_CHARGE.

fields.name: V_REPLENISH_TCOOL
fields.text: Replenish voltage in the Cool battery zone; coded as CHARGER_VOLTAGE_PARAM_REG.V_CHARGE.

fields.name: V_OVP_TWARM
fields.text: VBAT over-voltage protection level in the Warm battery zone; coded as CHARGER_VOLTAGE_PARAM_REG.V_CHARGE.

fields.name: V_OVP_TCOOL
fields.text: VBAT over-voltage protection level in the Cool battery zone; coded as CHARGER_VOLTAGE_PARAM_REG.V_CHARGE.

fields.name: I_PRECHARGE_TWARM
fields.text: Pre-Charge current in the Warm battery zone; coded as CHARGER_CURRENT_PARAM_REG.I_PRECHARGE.

fields.name: I_PRECHARGE_TCOOL
fields.text: Pre-Charge current in the Cool battery zone; coded as CHARGER_CURRENT_PARAM_REG.I_PRECHARGE.

fields.name: I_CHARGE_TWARM
fields.text: Charge current in the Warm battery zone; coded as CHARGER_CURRENT_PARAM_REG.I_CHARGE.

fields.name: I_CHARGE_TCOOL
fields.text: Charge current in the Cool battery zone; coded as CHARGER_CURRENT_PARAM_REG.I_CHARGE.

fields.name: VBAT_COMP_TIMER
fields.text: Present value of the timer that times the sampling of the Vbat comparator (Vbat against the Pre-Charge and Replenish levels). It counts down from VBAT_COMP_SETTLING; at 0 the digital block latches the comparator output for the FSM. In BYPASSED it is held at 0 and the comparator tests Vbat against Pre-Charge; software reads CHARGER_STATUS_REG.MAIN_VBAT_COMP_OUT periodically to see whether Vbat is above it.

fields.name: VBAT_COMP_SETTLING
fields.text: Settling time in us of the Vbat comparator that tests Vbat against the Pre-Charge and Replenish levels. Which level it uses is driven by the charger's digital block from the main FSM state (PRE_CHARGE, END_OF_CHARGE).

fields.name: OVP_INTERVAL_CHECK_TIMER
fields.text: Present count of the timer that paces sampling of the Over-Voltage Protection comparator output in PRE/CC/CV_CHARGE. In those states it counts on the 1 MHz clock from 0 to OVP_INTERVAL_CHECK_THRES; on reaching it the Vbat OVP comparator output is checked and the consecutive OVP event counter (CHARGER_STATUS_REG.OVP_EVENTS_DEBOUNCE_CNT) steps or not. Outside the charge states it is held at 0.

fields.name: VBAT_OVP_COMP_TIMER
fields.text: Present value of the timer that times the sampling of the Vbat Over-Voltage Protection comparator. It counts down from VBAT_OVP_COMP_SETTLING; at 0 the digital block latches the output for the main FSM. In BYPASSED it is held at 0 and software reads CHARGER_STATUS_REG.VBAT_OVP_COMP_OUT to see whether Vbat is over the OVP limit.

fields.name: OVP_INTERVAL_CHECK_THRES
fields.text: Interval between samples of the Vbat OVP comparator in PRE/CC/CV_CHARGE: the count OVP_INTERVAL_CHECK_TIMER climbs to from 0, counting only in those three states and held at 0 otherwise. Each time it is reached the comparator output is sampled and, if high, the consecutive OVP event counter (CHARGER_STATUS_REG.OVP_EVENTS_DEBOUNCE_CNT) steps up. Must be non-zero.

fields.name: VBAT_OVP_COMP_SETTLING
fields.text: Settling time in us of the Vbat comparator that tests Vbat against the over-voltage level.

fields.name: TDIE_COMP_TIMER
fields.text: Present value of the timer that times the sampling of the die temperature comparator. It counts down from TDIE_COMP_SETTLING; at 0 the digital block latches the output for the main FSM, and the count restarts so die temperature is watched continuously. In BYPASSED it is held at 0 and software reads CHARGER_STATUS_REG.TDIE_COMP_OUT to see whether the die limit is exceeded.

fields.name: TDIE_COMP_SETTLING
fields.text: Settling time in us of the die temperature comparator.

fields.name: TBAT_MON_TIMER
fields.text: Battery temperature monitoring timer, on the charger's 1 kHz clock. With CHARGER_CTRL_REG.TBAT_MONITOR_MODE at 0x1 or 0x2 it is loaded from TBAT_MON_INTERVAL and then counts down to 0 on the following 1 kHz ticks; at 0 the JEITA FSM runs again to refresh the battery temperature status.

fields.name: TBAT_MON_INTERVAL
fields.text: Battery temperature monitoring interval in ms: how often the JEITA FSM checks, and may update, the battery zone (Hot, Cold, Warm, Cool or Normal) from the two analogue battery temperature comparators, one for Hot and one for Cold, Cool and Warm. Must be non-zero.

fields.name: TBAT_COMP_TIMER
fields.text: Timer of the main battery temperature comparator, which times latching of its output; the JEITA FSM uses that output to find the battery pack's temperature status.

fields.name: TBAT_COMP_SETTLING
fields.text: Settling time in us of the main battery temperature comparator, which tests for the COOL, COLD and WARM levels. A dedicated timer counts down to 0, the output is latched, then the timer reloads with this value and counts down again. Must be non-zero.

fields.name: THOT_COMP_TIMER
fields.text: Timer of the battery temperature comparator for the Hot level.

fields.name: THOT_COMP_SETTLING
fields.text: Settling time in us of the battery temperature comparator for the Hot zone. A dedicated timer counts down to 0, the output is latched, then the timer reloads with this value and starts again. Must be non-zero.

fields.name: CHARGER_PWR_UP_TIMER
fields.text: Present value of the charger's power-up timer, on the 1 kHz clock. It reloads from CHARGER_PWR_UP_SETTLING when the analogue part is enabled after having been disabled. After clearing CHARGER_CTRL_REG[CHARGER_ENABLE], software must wait 1 ms (one 1 kHz period) before enabling again, so the timer's control signals in the digital part clear and the FSM starts up cleanly.

fields.name: CHARGER_PWR_UP_SETTLING
fields.text: Power-up settling time of the charger's analogue part. When CHARGER_CTRL_REG.CHARGER_ENABLE is set, a dedicated timer starts from this value and the FSM moves on only after it runs out. Must be non-zero.

fields.name: CV_TO_PRECHARGE_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables the Charger State IRQ on the FSM moving from CV_CHARGE to PRE_CHARGE.

fields.name: CC_TO_PRECHARGE_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables the Charger State IRQ on the FSM moving from CC_CHARGE to PRE_CHARGE.

fields.name: CV_TO_CC_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables the Charger State IRQ on the FSM moving from CV_CHARGE to CC_CHARGE.

fields.name: TBAT_STATUS_UPDATE_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables the Charger State IRQ each time the battery temperature (JEITA) FSM refreshes the battery status: having run, that FSM tells the main charger FSM the pack temperature has been checked and possibly updated.

fields.name: TBAT_PROT_TO_PRECHARGE_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables the Charger State IRQ on the FSM moving from TBAT_PROT to PRE_CHARGE, which resumes charging.

fields.name: TDIE_PROT_TO_PRECHARGE_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables the Charger State IRQ on the FSM moving from TDIE_PROT to PRE_CHARGE, which resumes charging.

fields.name: EOC_TO_PRECHARGE_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables the Charger State IRQ on the FSM moving from END_OF_CHARGE to PRE_CHARGE (Vbat found under the Replenish level).

fields.name: CV_TO_EOC_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables the Charger State IRQ on the FSM moving from CV_CHARGE to END_OF_CHARGE.

fields.name: CC_TO_EOC_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables the Charger State IRQ on the FSM moving from CC_CHARGE to END_OF_CHARGE.

fields.name: CC_TO_CV_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables the Charger State IRQ on the FSM moving from CC_CHARGE to CV_CHARGE.

fields.name: PRECHARGE_TO_CC_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables the Charger State IRQ on the FSM moving from PRE_CHARGE to CC_CHARGE.

fields.name: DISABLED_TO_PRECHARGE_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables the Charger State IRQ on the FSM moving from DISABLED to PRE_CHARGE.

fields.name: TBAT_ERROR_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables Battery temperature error IRQs, raised when the JEITA FSM, sampling the comparators, finds the battery in the Hot or Cold zone.

fields.name: TDIE_ERROR_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables Die temperature error IRQs, raised when a die error is caught and the FSM enters TDIE_PROT, which needs the die comparator to show the die above CHARGER_TEMPSET_PARAM_REG.TDIE_MAX.

fields.name: VBAT_OVP_ERROR_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables VBAT_OVP IRQs, raised when the dedicated comparator shows Vbat above the OVP level and the FSM has entered ERROR.

fields.name: TOTAL_CHARGE_TIMEOUT_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables total charge timeout IRQs, raised when the overall charge timer runs out to 0.

fields.name: CV_CHARGE_TIMEOUT_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables CV charge timeout IRQs, raised when the stage timer runs out to 0 in CV_CHARGE.

fields.name: CC_CHARGE_TIMEOUT_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables CC charge timeout IRQs, raised when the stage timer runs out to 0.

fields.name: PRECHARGE_TIMEOUT_IRQ_EN
fields.text: 1 enables Pre-Charge timeout IRQs, raised when the stage timer runs out to 0.

fields.name: CV_TO_PRECHARGE_IRQ
fields.text: CV_CHARGE to PRE_CHARGE transition flag.

values.text: No CV_CHARGE to PRE_CHARGE move seen.
FSM has moved from CV_CHARGE to PRE_CHARGE.

fields.name: CC_TO_PRECHARGE_IRQ
fields.text: CC_CHARGE to PRE_CHARGE transition flag.

values.text: No CC_CHARGE to PRE_CHARGE move seen.
FSM has moved from CC_CHARGE to PRE_CHARGE.

fields.name: CV_TO_CC_IRQ
fields.text: CV_CHARGE to CC_CHARGE transition flag.

values.text: No CV_CHARGE to CC_CHARGE move seen.
FSM has moved from CV_CHARGE to CC_CHARGE.

fields.name: TBAT_STATUS_UPDATE_IRQ
fields.text: Battery temperature status update flag.

values.text: No battery temperature status update seen.
The battery temperature monitor FSM has checked and refreshed the pack status; software should read the new status.

fields.name: TBAT_PROT_TO_PRECHARGE_IRQ
fields.text: TBAT_PROT to PRE_CHARGE transition flag.

values.text: No TBAT_PROT to PRE_CHARGE move seen.
FSM has moved from TBAT_PROT to PRE_CHARGE, charging again after a battery temperature error cleared.

fields.name: TDIE_PROT_TO_PRECHARGE_IRQ
fields.text: TDIE_PROT to PRE_CHARGE transition flag.

values.text: No TDIE_PROT to PRE_CHARGE move seen.
FSM has moved from TDIE_PROT to PRE_CHARGE, charging again after a die temperature error cleared.

fields.name: EOC_TO_PRECHARGE_IRQ
fields.text: END_OF_CHARGE to PRE_CHARGE transition flag.

values.text: No END_OF_CHARGE to PRE_CHARGE move seen.
FSM has moved from END_OF_CHARGE to PRE_CHARGE.

fields.name: CV_TO_EOC_IRQ
fields.text: CV_CHARGE to END_OF_CHARGE transition flag.

values.text: No CV_CHARGE to END_OF_CHARGE move seen.
FSM has moved from CV_CHARGE to END_OF_CHARGE.

fields.name: CC_TO_EOC_IRQ
fields.text: CC_CHARGE to END_OF_CHARGE transition flag.

values.text: No CC_CHARGE to END_OF_CHARGE move seen.
FSM has moved from CC_CHARGE to END_OF_CHARGE.

fields.name: CC_TO_CV_IRQ
fields.text: CC_CHARGE to CV_CHARGE transition flag.

values.text: No CC_CHARGE to CV_CHARGE move seen.
FSM has moved from CC_CHARGE to CV_CHARGE.

fields.name: PRECHARGE_TO_CC_IRQ
fields.text: PRE_CHARGE to CC_CHARGE transition flag.

values.text: No PRE_CHARGE to CC_CHARGE move seen.
FSM has moved from PRE_CHARGE to CC_CHARGE.

fields.name: DISABLED_TO_PRECHARGE_IRQ
fields.text: DISABLED to PRE_CHARGE transition flag.

values.text: No DISABLED to PRE_CHARGE move seen.
FSM has moved from DISABLED to PRE_CHARGE.

fields.name: TBAT_ERROR_IRQ
fields.text: 0: no battery temperature error event; charging may go on. 1: a battery temperature error event was caught and the FSM has entered TBAT_PROT. The bit is set by itself when the battery is found in the HOT or COLD zone, whatever its IRQ mask bit holds.

fields.name: TDIE_ERROR_IRQ
fields.text: 0: no die temperature error event; charging may go on. 1: a die temperature error event was caught; the FSM has entered TDIE_PROT and charging stops by itself. The bit is set by itself when the die exceeds the programmed level, whatever its IRQ mask bit holds; every bit of CHARGER_ERROR_IRQ_STATUS_REG behaves the same way.

fields.name: VBAT_OVP_ERROR_IRQ
fields.text: Vbat over-voltage error flag.

values.text: Vbat within the Over-Voltage Protection level; charging may go on.
Vbat went above the over-voltage level and an OVP error is recorded; once the digital part catches it, the FSM enters ERROR and charging stops by itself.

fields.name: TOTAL_CHARGE_TIMEOUT_IRQ
fields.text: Total charge timeout flag.

values.text: Overall charge counter still short of the maximum in CHARGER_TOTAL_CHARGE_TIMER_REG.
Overall charge counter reached the set maximum; once caught, the FSM enters ERROR and charging stops by itself.

fields.name: CV_CHARGE_TIMEOUT_IRQ
fields.text: 0: the stage charge time counter is still short of the maximum CV time in CHARGER_CV_CHARGE_TIMER_REG. 1: the counter has reached the programmed maximum CV time; once the event is caught, the FSM enters ERROR and charging stops by itself.

fields.name: CC_CHARGE_TIMEOUT_IRQ
fields.text: CC charge timeout flag.

values.text: Stage counter still short of the maximum CC time in CHARGER_CC_CHARGE_TIMER_REG.
Charge time counter reached the set maximum CC time; once caught, the FSM enters ERROR and charging stops by itself.

fields.name: PRECHARGE_TIMEOUT_IRQ
fields.text: Pre-charge timeout flag.

values.text: Stage counter still short of the maximum Pre-charge time in CHARGER_PRE_CHARGE_TIMER_REG.
Charge time counter reached the set maximum Pre-charge time; once caught, the FSM enters ERROR and charging stops by itself.

fields.name: QSPI2_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the clock of the QSPI RAM controller.

fields.name: QSPI2_DIV
fields.text: Clock divider for the QSPI RAM controller: 00 passes the clock straight through, 01 halves it, 10 divides it by 4, 11 divides it by 8.

fields.name: QSPI_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the clock of the QSPI controller.

fields.name: QSPI_DIV
fields.text: Clock divider for the QSPI controller: 00 passes the clock straight through, 01 halves it, 10 divides it by 4, 11 divides it by 8.

fields.name: OTP_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the clock of the OTP controller.

fields.name: TRNG_CLK_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the clock of the TRNG.

fields.name: AES_CLK_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the clock of the AES crypto engine.

fields.name: PCLK_DIV
fields.text: Divides HCLK down to the APB interface clock: 00 by 1, 01 by 2, 10 by 4, 11 by 8.

fields.name: HCLK_DIV
fields.text: Divides the source clock down to the AHB and processor clock: 000 by 1, 001 by 2, 010 by 4, 011 by 8, 1xx by 16.

fields.name: RFCU_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the clock of the RF control unit.

fields.name: CMAC_SYNCH_RESET
fields.text: Holds the CMAC core and the sleep timer in synchronous reset, clearing the CMAC CPU and all CMAC registers including retained ones; works only with the radio and timer power domains up and their clocks running, and must be held long enough for the CMAC, low-power and APB clocks to see it.

fields.name: CMAC_CLK_SEL
fields.text: Picks the CMAC clock: 1 takes the DIV1 clock, 0 the DIVN clock.

fields.name: CMAC_CLK_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the CMAC clock.

fields.name: CMAC_DIV
fields.text: Divider for the CMAC clock: 0x0 by 1, 0x1 by 2, 0x2 by 4, 0x3 by 8.

fields.name: RUNNING_AT_PLL96M
fields.text: Reads 1 while the system runs on the 96 MHz PLL, which then must not be turned off.

fields.name: RUNNING_AT_XTAL32M
fields.text: Reads 1 while the system runs on XTAL32M, which then must not be turned off.

fields.name: RUNNING_AT_RC32M
fields.text: Reads 1 while the system runs on RC32M.

fields.name: RUNNING_AT_LP_CLK
fields.text: Reads 1 while the system runs on LP_CLK.

fields.name: USB_CLK_SRC
fields.text: Source of the USB clock: 0 is the PLL clock halved, 1 is HCLK.

fields.name: LP_CLK_SEL
fields.text: Source of the low power clock: 0x0 RC32K, 0x1 RCX, 0x2 XTAL32K running its oscillator with an external crystal, 0x3 XTAL32K fed by an external square wave (with the GPIO's PID set to FUNC_GPIO).

fields.name: SYS_CLK_SEL
fields.text: System clock source: 0x0 XTAL32M, 0x1 RC32M, 0x2 the low power clock, 0x3 the 96 MHz PLL.

fields.name: TMR2_PWM_AON_MODE
fields.text: Routes the Timer2 PWM output to P1_06 and keeps that routing through deep sleep, so the pad can carry PWM while asleep.

fields.name: TMR_PWM_AON_MODE
fields.text: Routes the Timer1 PWM output to P1_01 and keeps that routing through deep sleep, so the pad can carry PWM while asleep.

fields.name: WAKEUPCT_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the wakeup controller clock.

fields.name: SWITCH2XTAL
fields.text: A write switches the system clock from RC32M to XTAL32M; ignored when the current clock is anything other than RC32M.

fields.name: ENABLE_CLKLESS
fields.text: Picks clockless deep sleep with asynchronous wakeup: at 1, lp_clk stops in deep sleep until WAKUPCT sees an undebounced wakeup event; at 0, lp_clk keeps running and the MAC counters keep counting. Not usable with regulated sleep: SLEEP_TIMER stays 0 with it.

fields.name: RETAIN_CACHE
fields.text: Cache state in deep sleep: 1 keeps it retained, 0 powers it off.

fields.name: SYS_SLEEP
fields.text: At 1, PD_SYS powers down once the PDC holds no pending IRQ for the M33; the PDC handles wakeup.

fields.name: RESET_ON_WAKEUP
fields.text: Does a hardware reset on wakeup, which starts the booter.

fields.name: MAP_BANDGAP_EN
fields.text: At 1, puts bandgap_enable on P0_25 and (wokenup OR cmac_slp_timer_expire) on P0_16.

fields.name: COM_SLEEP
fields.text: Powers down the communications domain PD_COM.

fields.name: TIM_SLEEP
fields.text: Powers down the timers domain PD_TIM.

fields.name: RADIO_SLEEP
fields.text: Powers down PD_RAD, the radio's digital part including CMAC.

fields.name: PERIPH_SLEEP
fields.text: Powers down the peripherals domain PD_PER.

fields.name: SW_RESET
fields.text: Writing 1 triggers a software reset.

fields.name: CACHERAM_MUX
fields.text: Decides whether the cache RAM is mapped: 0 bypasses the cache controller and leaves the cache RAM visible in the memory space; 1 turns the cache controller on and hides the cache RAM from the memory space.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_DISABLE
fields.text: Turns off the power state machine timeout; by default the machine moves on if the blocks have not started within 2 ms, which ANA_STATUS_REG shows.

fields.name: DEBUGGER_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the debugger; the booter sets it from the OTP header. While 0, SWDIO and SW_CLK are free for GPIO.

fields.name: QSPI_INIT
fields.text: Runs QSPI initialization after wakeup.

fields.name: REMAP_INTVECT
fields.text: 0 is normal operation. 1 redirects ARM accesses to addresses 0 to 0x1FF onto SYSRAM 0x0080.0000 to 0x0080.01FF, so the interrupt vector table can sit in RAM while code runs from QSPI.

fields.name: REMAP_ADR0
fields.text: Memory seen at address 0x0000 for execution: 0x0 ROM; 0x1 OTP uncached; 0x2 QSPI flash cached, with address 0 landing on FLASH_REGION_BASE + FLASH_REGION_OFFSET<<2 and the CPU limited, in the 0x16000000 range, to the span from that address over FLASH_REGION_SIZE, while all of the flash stays readable uncached through 0x36000000; 0x3 RAMs uncached; 0x4 QSPI flash uncached, verification only; 0x5 SYSRAM2, testing only; 0x6 cache data RAM uncached (CACHERAM_MUX=0), testing only, where that RAM, mirrored, accepts 8, 16 and 32 bit accesses but no 64 bit ones and no DMA.

fields.name: POWER_IS_UP
fields.text: Reads 1 once the startup state machine has finished and all power regulation is settled; in UltraFastWakeup mode software waits for it before heavy traffic.

fields.name: DBG_IS_ACTIVE
fields.text: Reads 1 while a debugger is attached.

fields.name: COM_IS_UP
fields.text: Reads 1 when PD_COM is working.

fields.name: COM_IS_DOWN
fields.text: Reads 1 when PD_COM is powered down.

fields.name: TIM_IS_UP
fields.text: Reads 1 when PD_TIM is working.

fields.name: TIM_IS_DOWN
fields.text: Reads 1 when PD_TIM is powered down.

fields.name: MEM_IS_UP
fields.text: Reads 1 when PD_MEM is working.

fields.name: MEM_IS_DOWN
fields.text: Reads 1 when PD_MEM is powered down.

fields.name: SYS_IS_UP
fields.text: Reads 1 when PD_SYS is working.

fields.name: SYS_IS_DOWN
fields.text: Reads 1 when PD_SYS is powered down.

fields.name: PER_IS_UP
fields.text: Reads 1 when PD_PER is working.

fields.name: PER_IS_DOWN
fields.text: Reads 1 when PD_PER is powered down.

fields.name: RAD_IS_UP
fields.text: Reads 1 when PD_RAD is working.

fields.name: RAD_IS_DOWN
fields.text: Reads 1 when PD_RAD is powered down.

fields.name: RC32K_TRIM
fields.text: Frequency trim of the 32 kHz RC oscillator.

fields.name: RC32K_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the 32 kHz RC oscillator.

fields.name: XTAL32K_DISABLE_AMPREG
fields.text: At 1, turns off amplitude regulation of the 32 kHz crystal oscillator; 1 for an external clock into XTAL32Kp, 0 for a crystal across XTAL32Kp and XTAL32Km.

fields.name: XTAL32K_CUR
fields.text: Bias current of the 32 kHz crystal oscillator, from 0000 (least) to 1111 (most), default 0011; each application has a setting that gives the best startup.

fields.name: XTAL32K_RBIAS
fields.text: Bias resistor setting, from 00 (largest) to 11 (smallest); Dialog supplies the preferred value.

fields.name: XTAL32K_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the 32 kHz crystal oscillator.

fields.name: RC32M_INIT_RANGE
fields.text: Coarse frequency trim.

fields.name: RC32M_INIT_DEL
fields.text: Fine frequency trim.

fields.name: RC32M_INIT_DTCF
fields.text: Fine trim of the RC32M duty cycle: 0x0 minimum, 0x2 default, 0x4 maximum; 0x5 to 0x7 stop the oscillator working.

fields.name: RC32M_INIT_DTC
fields.text: Coarse trim of the RC32M duty cycle: 0x0 minimum, 0x5 default, 0xA maximum; 0xB to 0xF stop the oscillator working.

fields.name: RC32M_BIAS
fields.text: Bias trim.

fields.name: RC32M_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the 32 MHz RC oscillator.

fields.name: RCX_BIAS
fields.text: Bias current of the RCX LDO, from 0x0 (least) to 0xF (most).

fields.name: RCX_C0
fields.text: Adds one unit capacitance to the RC delay.

fields.name: RCX_CADJUST
fields.text: Trims the capacitance in the RCX RC delay, from 0x00 (least capacitance) to 0x1F (most).

fields.name: RCX_RADJUST
fields.text: Trims the resistance in the RCX RC delay: 0 gives the most resistance, 1 the least; less resistance draws more power.

fields.name: RCX_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the RCX oscillator.

fields.name: RTC_RESET_REQ
fields.text: Requests a reset of the RTC.

fields.name: RTC_DIV_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the 100 Hz generator for the RTC.

fields.name: RTC_DIV_DENOM
fields.text: Denominator of the fractional divider: 0 gives 1000, 1 gives 1024.

fields.name: RTC_DIV_INT
fields.text: Integer part of the divisor that makes the RTC's 100 Hz.

fields.name: RTC_DIV_FRAC
fields.text: Fractional part of the 100 Hz divisor: in every 1024 cycles (RTC_DIV_DENOM=1) or 1000 cycles (RTC_DIV_DENOM=0), RTC_DIV_FRAC of them divide by RTC_DIV_INT+1 and the others by RTC_DIV_INT.

fields.name: BANDGAP_ENABLE_CLAMP
fields.text: Turns on a supply clamp in the bandgap that raises PSRR; software turns it on after a cold boot.

fields.name: BGR_ITRIM
fields.text: Bias current trim.

fields.name: BGR_TRIM
fields.text: Bandgap trim.

fields.name: VBUS_IRQ_EN_RISE
fields.text: At 1, VBUS_IRQ fires when VBUS begins rising above the threshold.

fields.name: VBUS_IRQ_EN_FALL
fields.text: At 1, VBUS_IRQ fires when VBUS begins falling below the threshold.

fields.name: VBUS_IRQ_CLEAR
fields.text: A write of any value clears the VBUS_IRQ line.

fields.name: BOD_V14_RST_EN
fields.text: At 1, a brown-out on V14 causes a power-on reset.

fields.name: BOD_V18F_RST_EN
fields.text: At 1, a brown-out on V18F causes a power-on reset.

fields.name: BOD_VDD_RST_EN
fields.text: At 1, a brown-out on VDD causes a power-on reset.

fields.name: BOD_V18P_RST_EN
fields.text: At 1, a brown-out on V18P causes a power-on reset.

fields.name: BOD_V18_RST_EN
fields.text: At 1, a brown-out on V18 causes a power-on reset.

fields.name: BOD_V30_RST_EN
fields.text: At 1, a brown-out on V30 causes a power-on reset.

fields.name: BOD_VBAT_RST_EN
fields.text: At 1, a brown-out on VBAT causes a power-on reset.

fields.name: BOD_V14_EN
fields.text: Turns on brown-out detection on V14.

fields.name: BOD_V18F_EN
fields.text: Turns on brown-out detection on V18F.

fields.name: BOD_VDD_EN
fields.text: Turns on brown-out detection on VDD.

fields.name: BOD_V18P_EN
fields.text: Turns on brown-out detection on V18P.

fields.name: BOD_V18_EN
fields.text: Turns on brown-out detection on V18.

fields.name: BOD_V30_EN
fields.text: Turns on brown-out detection on V30.

fields.name: BOD_VBAT_EN
fields.text: Turns on brown-out detection on VBAT.

fields.name: BOD_STATUS_CLEAR
fields.text: Clears BOD_STATUS_REG.

fields.name: BOD_CLK_DIV
fields.text: Divides the 1 MHz BOD_CLK for the brown-out detector: 0x0 by 1, 0x1 by 2, 0x2 by 4, 0x3 by 8.

fields.name: BOD_LVL_V18
fields.text: Brown-out threshold on V18, VTH_BOD = 1.2 * (BOD_LVL+1)/192; turn the channel off before changing it.

fields.name: BOD_LVL_V30
fields.text: Brown-out threshold on V30, VTH_BOD = 1.2 * (BOD_LVL+1)/192; turn the channel off before changing it.

fields.name: BOD_LVL_VBAT
fields.text: Brown-out threshold on VBAT, VTH_BOD = 1.5 * (1.2 * (BOD_LVL+1)/192); turn the channel off before changing it.

fields.name: BOD_LVL_VDD_RET
fields.text: Brown-out threshold on VDD during sleep, VTH_BOD = 1.2 * (BOD_LVL+1)/192; turn the channel off before changing it.

fields.name: BOD_LVL_VDD_ON
fields.text: Brown-out threshold on VDD while active, VTH_BOD = 1.2 * (BOD_LVL+1)/192; turn the channel off before changing it.

fields.name: BOD_LVL_V18P
fields.text: Brown-out threshold on V18P, VTH_BOD = 1.2 * (BOD_LVL+1)/192; turn the channel off before changing it.

fields.name: BOD_LVL_V14
fields.text: Brown-out threshold on V14, VTH_BOD = 1.2 * (BOD_LVL+1)/192; turn the channel off before changing it.

fields.name: BOD_LVL_V18F
fields.text: Brown-out threshold on V18F, VTH_BOD = 1.2 * (BOD_LVL+1)/192; turn the channel off before changing it.

fields.name: P0_LATCH_EN
fields.text: One bit per pad drives its latch signal directly; the latch holds the pad's control signals through powerdown. 0 keeps the control signals held, 1 makes the latch transparent so the pad can be controlled again.

fields.name: P0_SET_LATCH_EN
fields.text: Writing 1 sets the matching bits of P0_PAD_LATCH_REG; reads 0x0.

fields.name: P0_RESET_LATCH_EN
fields.text: Writing 1 clears the matching bits of P0_PAD_LATCH_REG; reads 0x0.

fields.name: P1_LATCH_EN
fields.text: One bit per pad drives its latch signal directly; the latch holds the pad's control signals through powerdown. 0 keeps the control signals held, 1 makes the latch transparent so the pad can be controlled again.

fields.name: P1_SET_LATCH_EN
fields.text: Writing 1 sets the matching bits of P1_PAD_LATCH_REG; reads 0x0.

fields.name: P1_RESET_LATCH_EN
fields.text: Writing 1 clears the matching bits of P1_PAD_LATCH_REG; reads 0x0.

fields.name: BOD_V14
fields.text: Brown-out status of V14.

fields.name: BOD_V18F
fields.text: Brown-out status of V18F.

fields.name: BOD_VDD
fields.text: Brown-out status of VDD.

fields.name: BOD_V18P
fields.text: Brown-out status of V18P.

fields.name: BOD_V18
fields.text: Brown-out status of V18.

fields.name: BOD_V30
fields.text: Brown-out status of V30.

fields.name: BOD_VBAT
fields.text: Brown-out status of VBAT.

fields.name: POR_VBAT_MASK_N
fields.text: Lets the generated POR pass on.

fields.name: POR_VBAT_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on POR generation.

fields.name: POR_VBAT_HYST_LOW
fields.text: POR hysteresis in 20 mV steps; set to 0x2 when the low threshold control is 0xF.

fields.name: POR_VBAT_THRES_LOW
fields.text: Low-side (CTAT) part of the POR threshold, in volts per code: 0xC for 1.25, 1.27, 1.29 and 1.31; 0x0 1.44, 0x1 1.49, 0x2 1.53, 0x3 1.58, 0x4 1.63, 0x5 1.68, 0x6 1.73, 0x7 1.78, 0x8 1.83, 0x9 1.87, 0xA 1.92, 0xB 1.97; 0xF 1.63, allowed only when POR_VBAT_THRES_LOW is 0x6 and POR_VBAT_THRES_HYST is 0x2.

fields.name: POR_PIN_POLARITY
fields.text: Active level of the POR on a GPIO pin: 0 active low, 1 active high. It applies to the GPIO pin only; the reset pad is always active high.

fields.name: POR_PIN_SELECT
fields.text: Pin that generates POR: 0x00 to 0x1F are P0_00 to P0_31, 0x20 to 0x36 are P1_00 to P1_22, 0x37 to 0x3E are reserved, 0x3F turns POR generation off.

fields.name: POR_TIME
fields.text: Time until the POR happens: POR_TIME x 4096 RC32 clock periods; the default is about 3 s.

fields.name: LDO_VDDD_HIGH_LOW_ZOUT_DISABLE
fields.text: Turns off the low-Zout switch that grounds the LDO output: at 0 a disabled LDO's output is pulled to ground, at 1 it floats.

fields.name: LDO_VDDD_HIGH_STATIC_LOAD_ENABLE
fields.text: Puts a static load of about 10 uA on the LDO VDDD_HIGH output.

fields.name: LDO_VDDD_HIGH_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns LDO VDDD_HIGH on.

fields.name: LDO_VDDD_HIGH_VREF_HOLD
fields.text: How LDO_VDDD_HIGH takes its reference input: 0 tracks it, 1 samples it.

fields.name: BIAS_VREF_RF2_SEL
fields.text: Reference voltage for RF2, coded as in BIAS_VREF_RF1_SEL.

fields.name: BIAS_VREF_RF1_SEL
fields.text: RF1 bias reference voltage: code N gives 900 mV + N x 30 mV, from 0 (900 mV) to 15 (1350 mV).

fields.name: CMAC_WDOGRESET_STAT
fields.text: Set by a CMAC watchdog timeout; a POR sets it too.

fields.name: SWD_HWRESET_STAT
fields.text: Set by a write to SWD_RESET_REG; a POR sets it too.

fields.name: WDOGRESET_STAT
fields.text: Set by a watchdog timeout; a POR sets it too.

fields.name: SWRESET_STAT
fields.text: Set by a software reset.

fields.name: HWRESET_STAT
fields.text: Set by a hardware reset.

fields.name: PORESET_STAT
fields.text: Set by a power-on reset. Read every field of RESET_STAT_REG to find the reset source, then clear them to 0 so the hardware can set the right ones at the next reset.

fields.name: RAM8_PWR_CTRL
fields.text: Power state of RAM8, coded as RAM1_PWR_CTRL.

fields.name: RAM7_PWR_CTRL
fields.text: Power state of RAM7, coded as RAM1_PWR_CTRL.

fields.name: RAM6_PWR_CTRL
fields.text: Power state of RAM6, coded as RAM1_PWR_CTRL.

fields.name: RAM5_PWR_CTRL
fields.text: Power state of RAM5, coded as RAM1_PWR_CTRL.

fields.name: RAM4_PWR_CTRL
fields.text: Power state of RAM4, coded as RAM1_PWR_CTRL.

fields.name: RAM3_PWR_CTRL
fields.text: Power state of RAM3, coded as RAM1_PWR_CTRL.

fields.name: RAM2_PWR_CTRL
fields.text: Power state of RAM2, coded as RAM1_PWR_CTRL.

fields.name: RAM1_PWR_CTRL
fields.text: Power state of this RAM, to be changed only while it is not being accessed. With PD_MEM up: 0x0 and 0x1 normal operation, 0x2 retained with no access, 0x3 off with contents lost. With PD_MEM down: 0x0 and 0x2 retained, 0x1 and 0x3 off with contents lost.

fields.name: PROT_QSPI_KEY_READ
fields.text: Permanently blocks CPU reads of the OTP segment starting at offset 0x00000B00.

fields.name: PROT_QSPI_KEY_WRITE
fields.text: Permanently blocks all writes to the OTP segment starting at offset 0x00000B00.

fields.name: PROT_AES_KEY_READ
fields.text: Permanently blocks CPU reads of the OTP segment starting at offset 0x00000A00.

fields.name: PROT_AES_KEY_WRITE
fields.text: Permanently blocks all writes to the OTP segment starting at offset 0x00000A00.

fields.name: PROT_SIG_KEY_WRITE
fields.text: Permanently blocks all writes to the OTP segment starting at offset 0x000008C0.

fields.name: FORCE_CMAC_DEBUGGER_OFF
fields.text: Permanently turns off the CMAC debugger.

fields.name: FORCE_DEBUGGER_OFF
fields.text: Mirrors its OTP flag and is written by the BootROM. 1 shuts the SWD debugger off completely; 0 leaves the debugger under control of DEBUGGER_ENABLE.

fields.name: SECURE_BOOT
fields.text: Mirrors its OTP flag and is written by the BootROM. 1 means the system is secure and supports secure boot; 0 means it does not support secure boot.

fields.name: RESET_V18P
fields.text: Writing 1 discharges the V18P rail at once, without turning off its source; 0 stops this forced discharge. It is ORed with the automatic discharge set by PMU_RESET_RAIL_REG.RESET_V18P.

fields.name: RESET_V18
fields.text: Writing 1 discharges the V18 rail at once, without turning off its source; 0 stops this forced discharge. It is ORed with the automatic discharge set by PMU_RESET_RAIL_REG.RESET_V18.

fields.name: RESET_V14
fields.text: Writing 1 discharges the V14 rail at once, without turning off its source; 0 stops this forced discharge. It is ORed with the automatic discharge set by PMU_RESET_RAIL_REG.RESET_V14.

fields.name: COMP_VBUS_HIGH
fields.text: Reads 1 when VBUS is over 4 V.

fields.name: COMP_VBUS_LOW
fields.text: Reads 1 when VBUS is over 3.4 V.

fields.name: COMP_VBAT_HIGH
fields.text: Reads 1 when VBAT is over 2.5 V.

fields.name: COMP_VBAT_LOW
fields.text: Reads 1 when VBAT is over 1.667 V.

fields.name: COMP_VDD_OK
fields.text: Reads 1 when VDD is over 1.125 V.

fields.name: VBUS_AVAILABLE
fields.text: Reads 1 when VBUS is over VBAT + 150 mV, with about 40 mV of hysteresis.

fields.name: BANDGAP_OK
fields.text: Reads 1 while the bandgap is active.

fields.name: LDO_3V0_VBAT_OK
fields.text: Reads 1 while LDO_VBAT is active.

fields.name: LDO_3V0_VBUS_OK
fields.text: Reads 1 while LDO_VBUS is active.

fields.name: LDO_1V8P_OK
fields.text: Reads 1 while LDO_IO2 is active.

fields.name: LDO_1V8_OK
fields.text: Reads 1 while LDO_IO is active.

fields.name: LDO_RADIO_OK
fields.text: Reads 1 while LDO_RADIO is active.

fields.name: LDO_CORE_OK
fields.text: Reads 1 while LDO_CORE (LDO1V2) is active.

fields.name: LDO_VDD_HIGH_OK
fields.text: Reads 1 while the ADC LDO, which also feeds part of the LRA, is active.

fields.name: BOD_VIN_NOK
fields.text: Combined brown-out flag: reads 1 when any monitored input is under its threshold.

fields.name: VDD_SLEEP_LEVEL
fields.text: VDD level while the sleep LDO runs it: 0x0 0.75 V, 0x1 0.80 V, 0x2 0.85 V, 0x3 0.90 V; 0x4 to 0x7 not applicable.

fields.name: VDD_CLAMP_LEVEL
fields.text: VDD level while the clamp holds it, unregulated, typical: 0x0 1037 mV, 0x1 1005, 0x2 978, 0x3 946, 0x4 1120, 0x5 1089, 0x6 1058, 0x7 1030, 0x8 952, 0x9 918, 0xA 889, 0xB 861, 0xC 862, 0xD 828, 0xE 798, 0xF 706 mV (set below the ldo_core_ret level).

fields.name: CLAMP_3V0_VBAT_ENABLE
fields.text: 1 turns on, 0 turns off, the clamp that can feed V30 from VBAT.

fields.name: V18_LEVEL
fields.text: V18 rail level: 0 gives 1.2 V, 1 gives 1.8 V.

fields.name: V14_LEVEL
fields.text: V14 rail level: code N gives 1.20 V + N x 0.05 V, from 0x0 (1.20 V) to 0x7 (1.55 V).

fields.name: V30_LEVEL
fields.text: V30 rail level: 0x0 3.0 V, 0x1 not to be used, 0x2 and 0x3 3.3 V.

fields.name: VDD_LEVEL
fields.text: VDD rail level: 0x0 0.9 V, 0x1 1.0 V, 0x2 1.1 V, 0x3 1.2 V.

fields.name: LDO_3V0_REF
fields.text: Reference for the V30 LDOs: 0 the VDD rail, 1 the bandgap output.

fields.name: LDO_CORE_RET_ENABLE_SLEEP
fields.text: 1 turns LDO_CORE_RET on in sleep, 0 off.

fields.name: LDO_CORE_RET_ENABLE_ACTIVE
fields.text: 1 turns LDO_CORE_RET on in active mode, 0 off.

fields.name: LDO_CORE_ENABLE
fields.text: 1 turns LDO_CORE on, 0 off.

fields.name: LDO_3V0_RET_ENABLE_SLEEP
fields.text: 1 turns LDO_3V0_RET on in sleep, 0 off.

fields.name: LDO_3V0_RET_ENABLE_ACTIVE
fields.text: 1 turns LDO_3V0_RET on in active mode, 0 off.

fields.name: LDO_3V0_MODE
fields.text: Mode of LDO_3V0: 0x0 off, 0x1 LDO_VBAT on, 0x2 LDO_VBUS on, 0x3 chooses LDO_VBAT or LDO_VBUS automatically.

fields.name: LDO_RADIO_ENABLE
fields.text: 1 turns LDO_RADIO on, 0 off.

fields.name: LDO_1V8_RET_ENABLE_SLEEP
fields.text: 1 turns LDO_1V8_RET on in sleep, 0 off.

fields.name: LDO_1V8_RET_ENABLE_ACTIVE
fields.text: 1 turns LDO_1V8_RET on in active mode, 0 off.

fields.name: LDO_1V8_ENABLE
fields.text: 1 turns LDO_1V8 on, 0 off.

fields.name: SW_1V8F_ENABLE_FORCE
fields.text: Forces the switch between the V18P and V18F rails closed.

fields.name: LDO_1V8P_RET_ENABLE_SLEEP
fields.text: 1 turns LDO_1V8P_RET on in sleep, 0 off.

fields.name: LDO_1V8P_RET_ENABLE_ACTIVE
fields.text: 1 turns LDO_1V8P_RET on in active mode, 0 off.

fields.name: LDO_1V8P_ENABLE
fields.text: 1 turns LDO_1V8P on, 0 off.

fields.name: CLAMP_VDD_WKUP_MAX
fields.text: Drives the VDD clamp to its highest voltage on wakeup from sleep.

fields.name: ULTRA_FAST_WAKEUP
fields.text: Lets the core run from RC32M while the PMU still waits for the supplies to reach their final level; only together with FAST_WAKEUP and VDD at 0.9 V in sleep.

fields.name: FAST_WAKEUP
fields.text: Shortens wakeup by turning all LDOs on together rather than one after another; only when every voltage was retained through sleep.

fields.name: BOD_SLEEP_INTERVAL
fields.text: How often brown-out detection runs to check the rails, counted in BG_REFRESH_INTERVALs.

fields.name: BG_REFRESH_INTERVAL
fields.text: How often the bandgap is turned on to refresh, in ticks of lp_clk/64 (for example 30.5 us x 64 = 1.9 ms).

fields.name: LDO_1V8_TRIM
fields.text: Trim of LDO_1V8, unsigned binary, range ±10 %.

fields.name: LDO_1V8P_TRIM
fields.text: Trim of LDO_1V8P, unsigned binary, range ±10 %.

fields.name: LDO_SUPPLY_VBAT_TRIM
fields.text: Trim of LDO_SUPPLY_VBAT, sign-magnitude, range ±10 %.

fields.name: LDO_SUPPLY_VBUS_TRIM
fields.text: Trim of LDO_SUPPLY_VBUS, sign-magnitude, range ±10 %.

fields.name: XTAL32M_START
fields.text: Crystal trim used in the START phase of XTAL32M startup. The crystal load is Cload = 5.0p + 6.09p * XTAL32M_TRIM/0x2BF, PCB parasitics of the reference design included; 0x2BF gives the lowest frequency (most load capacitance), 0x000 the highest (least).

fields.name: XTAL32M_RAMP
fields.text: Crystal trim used in the RAMP phase of XTAL32M startup. The crystal load is Cload = 5.0p + 6.09p * XTAL32M_TRIM/0x2BF, PCB parasitics of the reference design included; 0x2BF gives the lowest frequency (most load capacitance), 0x000 the highest (least).

fields.name: XTAL32M_TRIM
fields.text: Crystal frequency trim. The crystal load is Cload = 5.0p + 6.09p * XTAL32M_TRIM/0x2BF, PCB parasitics of the reference design included; 0x2BF gives the lowest frequency (most load capacitance), 0x000 the highest (least).

fields.name: XTAL_SETTLE_N
fields.text: Count at which the crystal is safe as CPU clock: XTAL_SETTLE_READY sets when XTAL_CLK_CNT reaches it.

fields.name: XTAL_TRIM_SELECT
fields.text: Picks what drives the crystal trim. 0b00, crystal counter: starts with XTAL32M_START and moves to XTAL32M_TRIM after COUNT_N x 32 crystal pulses. 0b01, crystal-OK filter: starts with XTAL32M_START and moves to XTAL32M_TRIM once the crystal ramps. 0b10, forced off: XTAL32M_TRIM only. 0b11, two-stage crystal-OK filter: starts with XTAL32M_START, moves to XTAL32M_RAMP after the timeout (sw1=1, XTAL32M_CTRL0_REG.XTAL32M_SW_DELAY), then to XTAL32M_TRIM when sw2=1.

fields.name: XTAL_COUNT_N
fields.text: How many crystal cycles are counted before the trim is applied, in steps of 32: 0x01 is 32, 0x02 is 64, up to 0x3F at 2016.

fields.name: XTALRDY_CLK_SEL
fields.text: Clock of the XTALRDY IRQ timer: 0 is 32 kHz, 1 is 256 kHz.

fields.name: XTALRDY_CNT
fields.text: Count of 32 kHz or 256 kHz cycles (chosen by XTALRDY_CLK_SEL) from enabling the crystal to firing XTALRDY_IRQ; 0x00 gives no interrupt.

fields.name: XTALRDY_COUNT
fields.text: Present IRQ counter value.

fields.name: XTALRDY_STAT
fields.text: IRQ counter value captured when the trim moved from RAMP to TRIM.

fields.name: XTAL32M_DXTAL_SYSPLL_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on DXTAL for the system PLL.

fields.name: XTAL32M_CORE_CUR_SET
fields.text: Trim of the crystal core current: 0x0 least current, 0x3 default, 0x6 most amplitude; 0x7 acts as 0x3.

fields.name: XTAL32M_RCOSC_CALIBRATE
fields.text: Requests a calibration of the RC oscillator, run after crystal startup.

fields.name: XTAL32M_RCOSC_XTAL_DRIVE
fields.text: Lets the RC oscillator drive the crystal, which fast startup needs.

fields.name: XTAL32M_CXCOMP_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the shunt-capacitance compensation amplifier (OSF BOOST).

fields.name: XTAL32M_STARTUP_TDISCHARGE
fields.text: Discharge time in the startup: 0x0 off, 0x1 8 us, 0x2 4 us, 0x3 2 us, 0x4 1 us, 0x5 1/2 us, 0x6 1/8 us, 0x7 1/32 us.

fields.name: XTAL32M_STARTUP_TSETTLE
fields.text: Settle time in the startup: 0x0 16 us, halving with each code to 0x7 at 1/8 us.

fields.name: XTAL32M_XTAL_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the crystal (startup) or the crystal block (software control mode); for testing only, the PDC turns the crystal on in use.

fields.name: XTAL32M_STARTUP_TDRIVE_LSB
fields.text: Low part of the sequence drive time, 0 to 32 us in 1/32 us steps.

fields.name: XTAL32M_DRIVE_CYCLES
fields.text: How many drive sequences run at startup.

fields.name: XTAL32M_STARTUP_TDRIVE
fields.text: Drive time in the startup sequence: 0x0 32 us, halving with each code to 0x7 at 1/4 us.

fields.name: XTAL32M_RCOSC_SYNC_DELAY_TRIM
fields.text: Delay trim of the synchronization mode.

fields.name: XTAL32M_RCOSC_TRIM_SNS
fields.text: Trim sensitivity for RC oscillator calibration: 128/(M0 x S), where M0 = 8196 and S is the RCOSC sensitivity, about 128 ppm/LSB. S can be measured on-chip as (FreqDetHigh - FreqDetLow)/(M x D): the two readings are XTAL32M_STAT0_REG.FREQ_DET_OUT taken at trims T0 and T1 of XTAL32M_CTRL3_REG.XTAL32M_RCOSC_TRIM, D = T0 - T1, and M comes from XTAL32M_CTRL2_REG.XTAL32M_FREQ_DET_LEN. With XTAL32M_FREQ_DET_LEN = 1 the value is 64 x D/(FreqDetHigh - FreqDetLow).

fields.name: XTAL32M_CXCOMP_PHI_TRIM
fields.text: Phase correction of the cxcomp circuit.

fields.name: XTAL32M_CXCOMP_TRIM_CAP
fields.text: Size of the shunt-capacitance compensation capacitor.

fields.name: XTAL32M_RCOSC_TRIM_STROBE
fields.text: Forces the RC oscillator trim setting.

fields.name: XTAL32M_FREQ_DET_START
fields.text: Forces the frequency detector to start.

fields.name: XTAL32M_SW_CTRL_MODE
fields.text: Turns on all software overrides; the state machine stays in IDLE.

fields.name: XTAL32M_RCOSC_BAND_SELECT
fields.text: RCOSC band select, taken on RCOSC_TRIM_STROBE.

fields.name: XTAL32M_RCOSC_TRIM
fields.text: Fine RCOSC trim, taken on RCOSC_TRIM_STROBE.

fields.name: XTAL32M_RCOSC_BAND_SELECT_STAT
fields.text: Band now selected.

fields.name: XTAL32M_RCOSC_CALIBRATION_DONE
fields.text: Reads 1 once calibration has finished.

fields.name: XTAL32M_CAL_STATE
fields.text: Where the calibration sequencer is: 0x0 CAL_DELAY, waiting for the bias to settle; 0x1 CAL_SYNC, sync circuit on; 0x2 CAL_FREQDET, frequency detector on; 0x3 CAL_OFFSET, judging the offset trim result; 0x4 CAL_MULT_SHIFT, judging the delta trim result; 0x5 CAL_TRIM, making a new trim value; 0x6 CAL_BAND_UPDWN, waiting after a band change; 0x7 CAL_END, calibration done; 0x8 CAL_IDLE, idle (default).

fields.name: XTAL32M_STATE
fields.text: Where the crystal startup sequencer is: 0x0 XTAL_WAIT_LDO, bias settling; 0x1 XTAL_DRIVE, RC oscillator drives the crystal; 0x2 XTAL_DISCHARGE, load capacitors discharged; 0x3 XTAL_SETTLE, crystal signal settling; 0x4 XTAL_SYNC, RC oscillator restarted and synchronised; 0x5 XTAL_OVERLOAD_DETECT, amplitude found from the overload bit; 0x6 XTAL_OVERLOAD_BLANK_SETTLE, amplitude regulator settling after drive stops; 0x7 XTAL_OVERLOAD_BLANK, masking the glitch as gm_current turns on; 0x8 XTAL_RUN, startup done; 0x9 XTAL_SAMPLE, wait before sampling amplitude control; 0xA XTAL_SW2_MASK, wait for masked SW2; 0xB XTAL_IDLE, idle (default).

fields.name: PLL_SEL_MIN_CUR_INT
fields.text: Source of the PLL VCO current: 0 takes it from min_current<5:0>, 1 has a calibration algorithm find it internally.
