fields.text: Picks the PCM clock: 1 takes the DIV1 clock, 0 the DIVN clock.

fields.name: CLK_PCM_EN
fields.text: Turns on the internally made PCM clock; PCM_DIV is written before or with it.

fields.name: PCM_DIV
fields.text: PCM clock divider, at least 0x2.

fields.name: PCM_FDIV
fields.text: Fractional part of the PCM clock division: the highest 1 bit sets the denominator and the count of 1 bits the numerator; 0x0110 gives 2/9 spread as 1.0001.0000, 0xfeee gives 13/16 spread as 1111.1110.1110.1110.

fields.name: PDM_MASTER_MODE
fields.text: PDM interface role: 0 slave, 1 master.

fields.name: CLK_PDM_EN
fields.text: Turns on the internally made PDM clock; PDM_DIV is written before or with it.

fields.name: PDM_DIV
fields.text: PDM clock divider.

fields.name: CLK_SRC_EN
fields.text: Turns on the internally made SRC clock; SRC_DIV is written before or with it.

fields.name: SRC_DIV
fields.text: SRC clock divider.

fields.name: CLK_CHG_EN
fields.text: Turns on the clocks of the charger state machine.

fields.name: LCD_RESET_REQ
fields.text: Sends a software reset to the LCD controller.

fields.name: LCD_CLK_SEL
fields.text: Picks the LCD clock: 1 takes the DIV1 clock, 0 the DIVN clock.

fields.name: LCD_ENABLE
fields.text: Turns on the LCD clock.

fields.name: BATCHECK_LOAD_ENABLE
fields.text: Puts a current load on the battery.

fields.name: BATCHECK_ILOAD
fields.text: Battery load current, (ILOAD+1) mA.

fields.name: BATCHECK_TRIM
fields.text: Trims the battery check load current in 2.7% steps between -19.1% and +19.1%: codes 0 to 7 add 0, 2.7, 5.5, 8.2, 10.9, 13.6, 16.4 and 19.1%; codes 8 to 15 subtract the same amounts.

fields.name: CACHE_RES1
fields.text: Reserved; keep at 0.

fields.name: CACHE_FLUSH
fields.text: Writing 1 flushes the tag memories, invalidating the whole cache; reads 0. The flush takes 0x100 HCLK cycles with 8 KB of cache data RAM, 0x200 with 16 KB.

fields.name: CACHE_LINE
fields.text: Size of a cache line: 0 is 8 bytes, 1 is 16 bytes, 2 is 32 bytes, 3 is reserved. After changing to 8-byte lines at run time, flush the cache by writing 01 to CACHE_CTRL1_REG right after writing 00 here.

fields.name: CACHE_ASSOC
fields.text: Associativity of the cache: 0 one way (direct mapped), 1 two way, 2 four way, 3 reserved.

fields.name: CACHE_CGEN
fields.text: Clock gating of the cache controller: 0 off, 1 on, saving power. It must be 0 (its default) when CACHE_FLUSH is set while code runs from anywhere other than cached QSPI flash, such as the booter or SYSRAM.

fields.name: CACHE_WEN
fields.text: Access to the cache data and TAG memories: 0 read only, 1 read and write. Only the cache controller updates them, and no hardware stops the ARM from reaching them. Through the memory map, the data memory takes only 32-bit accesses and the TAG memory only 16-bit accesses.

fields.name: CACHE_LEN
fields.text: Cacheable length of QSPI flash in 64 KB blocks, N from 0 to 512 (32 MB at most); 0 turns the cache off. The useful maximum follows the chosen flash region size, and the first block (1) holds the space set by CACHE_FLASH_REG.FLASH_REGION_OFFSET.

fields.name: MRM_HITS
fields.text: Count of cache hits.

fields.name: MRM_MISSES
fields.text: Count of cache misses.

fields.name: MRM_IRQ_HITS_THRES_STATUS
fields.text: Reads 1 when an interrupt pulse was raised because the cache hit count reached its nonzero threshold; 0 when none was raised.

values.text: Pulse interrupt raised: the hit count reached its nonzero threshold.

fields.name: MRM_IRQ_MISSES_THRES_STATUS
fields.text: Reads 1 when an interrupt pulse was raised because the cache miss count reached its nonzero threshold; 0 when none was raised.

values.text: Pulse interrupt raised: the miss count reached its nonzero threshold.

fields.name: MRM_IRQ_TINT_STATUS
fields.text: Reads 1 when an interrupt pulse was raised because the nonzero time interval counter ran out; 0 when none was raised.

values.text: Pulse interrupt raised: the nonzero time interval counter ran out.

fields.name: MRM_IRQ_MASK
fields.text: Lets the cache MRM raise its interrupt, a pulse to the ARM processor: 0 off, 1 on.

fields.name: MRM_START
fields.text: 0 freezes the hit and miss counters and reloads the interval counter from CACHE_MRM_TINT_REG; 1 starts the counters. With a nonzero CACHE_MRM_TINT_REG the interval counter counts down on a fixed 16 MHz clock to 0, when hardware clears this bit and raises the MRM interrupt.

fields.name: MRM_TINT
fields.text: Monitoring interval in 32 MHz clock cycles; 0 gives no interrupt.

fields.name: MRM_MISSES_THRES
fields.text: Miss count that raises the interrupt; 0 gives no interrupt.

fields.name: MRM_HITS_THRES
fields.text: Hit count that raises the interrupt; 0 gives no interrupt.

fields.name: FLASH_REGION_BASE
fields.text: Bits [31:16] of the flash region base address, default 0x1600; bits [31:25] are fixed at 0x16 and [17:16] at 0x0. Retained; a new value applies only after a software reset, and the base allowed depends on the flash region size.

fields.name: FLASH_REGION_OFFSET
fields.text: Flash region offset in words, added to CPU address bits [13:2]. Retained; a new value applies only after a software reset.

fields.name: FLASH_REGION_SIZE
fields.text: Size of the flash region: 0 32 MB, 1 16 MB, 2 8 MB, 3 4 MB, 4 2 MB, 5 1 MB, 6 0.5 MB (default), 7 0.25 MB. Retained; a newly written size applies from the next software reset.

fields.name: SWD_HW_RESET_REQ
fields.text: Writing 1 requests a hardware reset from the debugger; 0 is the default. HW_RESET clears it, and only debugger software can reach it, not the application.

fields.name: SRC_PDM_DO_DEL
fields.text: Typical delay on the PDM_DO output: 0 none, 1 8 ns, 2 12 ns, 3 16 ns.

fields.name: SRC_PDM_MODE
fields.text: What PDM_DO1 outputs: 00 nothing, 01 right channel from SRC1_IN_REG, 10 left channel from SRC2_IN_REG, 11 both channels.

fields.name: SRC_PDM_DI_DEL
fields.text: Typical delay on the PDM_DI input: 0 none, 1 4 ns, 2 8 ns, 3 12 ns.

fields.name: SRC_OUT_FLOWCLR
fields.text: Writing 1 clears the SRC1_OUT overflow and underflow bits 23-22, and blocks new ones while it stays 1; hold it at 1 until those bits have cleared.

fields.name: SRC_IN_FLOWCLR
fields.text: Writing 1 clears the SRC1_IN overflow and underflow bits 21-20, and blocks new ones while it stays 1; hold it at 1 until those bits have cleared.

fields.name: SRC_OUT_UNFLOW
fields.text: SRC1_OUT underflow flag.

fields.name: SRC_OUT_OVFLOW
fields.text: SRC1_OUT overflow flag.

fields.name: SRC_IN_UNFLOW
fields.text: SRC1_IN underflow flag.

fields.name: SRC_IN_OVFLOW
fields.text: SRC1_IN overflow flag.

fields.name: SRC_RESYNC
fields.text: Restarts SRC synchronization.

fields.name: SRC_OUT_OK
fields.text: SRC1_OUT status: 0 acquisition running, 1 acquisition ready; always 1 in manual mode.

fields.name: SRC_OUT_US
fields.text: SRC1_OUT upsampling IIR filter setting: 00 sample rates up to 48 kHz, 01 96 kHz, 10 reserved, 11 192 kHz.

fields.name: SRC_OUT_CAL_BYPASS
fields.text: Bypasses the SRC1_OUT1 upsampling filter: 0 filter used, 1 bypassed.

fields.name: SRC_OUT_AMODE
fields.text: SRC1_OUT1 conversion mode: 0 manual, 1 automatic.

fields.name: SRC_PDM_OUT_INV
fields.text: Swaps the left and right PDM output channels.

fields.name: SRC_FIFO_DIRECTION
fields.text: Direction of the SRC FIFO: 0 holds samples going from memory to the SRC, 1 holds samples going from the SRC to memory.

values.text: Holds samples going from memory to the SRC.
Holds samples going from the SRC to memory.

fields.name: SRC_FIFO_ENABLE
fields.text: 0 turns the FIFO off, so each SRC request moves one sample and no burst is used; 1 turns it on to buffer samples to or from the SRC, and then only DMA bursts of 4 are supported.

fields.name: SRC_OUT_DSD_MODE
fields.text: SRC1 output format.

fields.name: SRC_IN_DSD_MODE
fields.text: SRC1 input format.

fields.name: SRC_DITHER_DISABLE
fields.text: Dithering: 0 on, 1 off.

fields.name: SRC_IN_OK
fields.text: SRC1_IN status: 0 acquisition running, 1 acquisition ready.

fields.name: SRC_IN_DS
fields.text: SRC1_IN upsampling IIR filter setting: 00 sample rates up to 48 kHz, 01 96 kHz, 10 reserved, 11 192 kHz.

fields.name: SRC_PDM_IN_INV
fields.text: Swaps the left and right PDM input channels.

fields.name: SRC_IN_CAL_BYPASS
fields.text: Bypasses the SRC1_IN upsampling filter: 0 filter used, 1 bypassed.

fields.name: SRC_IN_AMODE
fields.text: SRC1_IN conversion mode: 0 manual, 1 automatic.

fields.name: SRC_EN
fields.text: Turns SRC1_IN and SRC1_OUT on (1) or off (0).

fields.name: SRC_IN_FS
fields.text: Sample rate of SRC_IN: SRC_IN_FS = SRC_DIV x 4096 x rate/100, for rates up to 192 kHz. Codes for SRC_DIV=1, given as rate -> SRC_IN_FS / SRC_IN_DS / bandwidth, all rates in hertz: 8000 -> 0x050000 / 0 / 4000; 11025 -> 0x06E400 / 0 / 5512; 16000 -> 0x0A0000 / 0 / 8000; 22050 -> 0x0DC800 / 0 / 11025; 32000 -> 0x140000 / 0 / 16000; 44100 -> 0x1B9000 / 0 / 22050; 48000 -> 0x1E0000 / 0 / 24000; 96000 -> 0x1E0000 / 1 / 24000; 192000 -> 0x1E0000 / 3 / 24000. Manual mode lets software write and change it whenever it likes; automatic mode has the converter report the final rate here once SRC_IN_OK is set, though SRC_DS is never computed automatically and must be written by software for 96 and 192 kHz.

fields.name: SRC_OUT_FS
fields.text: Sample rate of SRC_OUT: SRC_OUT_FS = SRC_DIV x 4096 x rate/100, for rates up to 192 kHz. Codes for SRC_DIV=1, given as rate -> SRC_OUT_FS / SRC_OUT_DS / bandwidth, all rates in hertz: 8000 -> 0x050000 / 0 / 4000; 11025 -> 0x06E400 / 0 / 5512; 16000 -> 0x0A0000 / 0 / 8000; 22050 -> 0x0DC800 / 0 / 11025; 32000 -> 0x140000 / 0 / 16000; 44100 -> 0x1B9000 / 0 / 22050; 48000 -> 0x1E0000 / 0 / 24000; 96000 -> 0x1E0000 / 1 / 24000; 192000 -> 0x1E0000 / 3 / 24000. Manual mode lets software write and change it whenever it likes; automatic mode has the converter report the final rate here once SRC_OUT_OK is set, though SRC_DS is never computed automatically and must be written by software for 96 and 192 kHz.

fields.name: SRC_IN
fields.text: SRC1 input sample 1 (SRC1_IN1).

fields.name: SRC_IN
fields.text: SRC1 input sample 2 (SRC1_IN2).

fields.name: SRC_OUT
fields.text: SRC1 output sample 1 (SRC1_OUT1).

fields.name: SRC_OUT
fields.text: SRC1 output sample 2 (SRC1_OUT2).

fields.name: PDM1_MUX_IN
fields.text: PDM1 input select: 0 SRC1_MUX_IN, 1 the PDM input.

fields.name: PCM1_MUX_IN
fields.text: PCM1 input select: 0 off, 1 the SRC1 output, 2 the PCM output registers.

fields.name: SRC1_MUX_IN
fields.text: SRC1 input select: 0 off, 1 the PCM output, 2 the SRC1 input registers.

fields.name: SRC_COEF1
fields.text: SRC filter coefficient 1.

fields.name: SRC_COEF0
fields.text: SRC filter coefficient 0.

fields.name: SRC_COEF3
fields.text: SRC filter coefficient 3.

fields.name: SRC_COEF2
fields.text: SRC filter coefficient 2.

fields.name: SRC_COEF5
fields.text: SRC filter coefficient 5.

fields.name: SRC_COEF4
fields.text: SRC filter coefficient 4.

fields.name: SRC_COEF7
fields.text: SRC filter coefficient 7.

fields.name: SRC_COEF6
fields.text: SRC filter coefficient 6.

fields.name: SRC_COEF9
fields.text: SRC filter coefficient 9.

fields.name: SRC_COEF8
fields.text: SRC filter coefficient 8.

fields.name: SRC_COEF10
fields.text: SRC filter coefficient 10.

fields.name: PCM_FSC_DIV
fields.text: PCM frame sync divider, 7 to 0xFFF: write N-1 to divide by N; N-1 is at least 7 for an 8-bit PCM_FSC, and N is even whenever PCM_CLK_BIT=1.

fields.name: PCM_FSC_EDGE
fields.text: 0 shifts channels 1 to 8 after the PCM_FSC edge; 1 shifts channels 1 to 4 after the PCM_FSC edge and channels 5 to 8 after the opposite edge.

values.text: Channels 1 to 8 shift after the PCM_FSC edge.
Channels 1 to 4 shift after the PCM_FSC edge, channels 5 to 8 after the opposite edge.

fields.name: PCM_CH_DEL
fields.text: Channel delay in steps of 8 bits.

fields.name: PCM_CLK_BIT
fields.text: Clock cycles per data bit.

fields.name: PCM_FSCINV
fields.text: Inverts PCM FSC.

fields.name: PCM_CLKINV
fields.text: Inverts PCM CLK.

fields.name: PCM_PPOD
fields.text: Output type of PCM DO.

fields.name: PCM_FSCDEL
fields.text: PCM FSC timing: 0 starts it one cycle ahead of the MSB, 1 starts it with the MSB.

values.text: FSC begins one cycle ahead of the MSB.

fields.name: PCM_FSCLEN
fields.text: Length of PCM FSC: 0 is one data bit, N is N*8.

fields.name: PCM_MASTER
fields.text: PCM interface master or slave.

fields.name: PCM_EN
fields.text: Turns the PCM interface on.

fields.name: PCM_IN
fields.text: PCM1_IN1, bits 31-0.

fields.name: PCM_IN
fields.text: PCM1_IN2, bits 31-0.

fields.name: PCM_OUT
fields.text: PCM1_OUT1, bits 31-0.

fields.name: PCM_OUT
fields.text: PCM1_OUT2, bits 31-0.

fields.name: CAL_CLK_SEL
fields.text: Reference clock for calibration: 0x0 DIVN clock, 0x1 RC32K, 0x2 RC32M, 0x3 XTAL32K, 0x4 RCOSC; 0x5 to 0x7 reserved.

fields.name: EXT_CNT_EN_SEL
fields.text: What enables the XTAL_CNT counter: 0 the reference clock picked by REF_CLK_SEL, 1 an external input.

fields.name: REF_CAL_START
fields.text: Writing 1 starts a calibration; it clears when calibration ends and CLK_REF_VAL is ready.

fields.name: REF_CLK_SEL
fields.text: Clock to be calibrated: 0x0 RC32K, 0x1 RC32M, 0x2 XTAL32K, 0x3 RCX, 0x4 RCOSC.

fields.name: REF_CNT_VAL
fields.text: Calibration time, counted down to 1.

fields.name: XTAL_CNT_VAL
fields.text: DIVN clock cycles counted over the calibration time set by REF_CNT_VAL.

fields.name: CRYPTO_AES_KEXP
fields.text: When 1, the AES key expansion runs as the AES encryption or decryption starts; hardware clears the bit once the key expansion is done.

fields.name: CRYPTO_MORE_IN
fields.text: Says whether the current input block is the final one (0) or more input follows (1).

values.text: Last input block: once it is consumed and its output written to memory, the calculation ends and CRYPTO_INACTIVE becomes 1.
Not the last block: after using up this block the engine halts until more data arrives, with CRYPTO_WAIT_FOR_IN set to 1.

fields.name: CRYPTO_HASH_OUT_LEN
fields.text: Bytes of hash result the DMA writes to memory, minus one. Allowed range per algorithm: MD5 0-15 (1-16 bytes), SHA-1 0-19 (1-20), SHA-256 0-31 (1-32), SHA-256/224 0-27 (1-28), SHA-384 0-47 (1-48), SHA-512 0-63 (1-64), SHA-512/224 0-27 (1-28), SHA-512/256 0-31 (1-32).

fields.name: CRYPTO_HASH_SEL
fields.text: Algorithm family: 0 = AES encryption, 1 = a hash, the particular one chosen by CRYPTO_ALG and CRYPTO_ALG_MD.

fields.name: CRYPTO_IRQ_EN
fields.text: Interrupt enable: 0 = no interrupts; 1 = an interrupt request is raised when the operation ends.

fields.name: CRYPTO_ENCDEC
fields.text: Direction: 0 = decrypt, 1 = encrypt.

fields.name: CRYPTO_AES_KEY_SZ
fields.text: AES key length: 0x0 = 128 bits, 0x1 = 192 bits, 0x2 and 0x3 = 256 bits.

fields.name: CRYPTO_OUT_MD
fields.text: Output mode, used only with AES (CRYPTO_HASH_SEL = 0): 0 = all result data written back to memory, 1 = only the last result block written back.

fields.name: CRYPTO_ALG_MD
fields.text: With AES (CRYPTO_HASH_SEL = 0), the AES mode: 0x0 and 0x1 = ECB, 0x2 = CTR, 0x3 = CBC. With a hash, it picks the hash group together with CRYPTO_ALG: 0x0 = hashes built on 32-bit operations, 0x1 = hashes built on 64-bit operations, 0x2 and 0x3 reserved.

fields.name: CRYPTO_ALG
fields.text: Algorithm. With CRYPTO_HASH_SEL = 0: 0x0 = AES, 0x1 to 0x3 reserved. With CRYPTO_HASH_SEL = 1 and CRYPTO_ALG_MD = 0x0: 0x0 = MD5, 0x1 = SHA-1, 0x2 = SHA-256/224, 0x3 = SHA-256. With CRYPTO_HASH_SEL = 1 and CRYPTO_ALG_MD = 0x1: 0x0 = SHA-384, 0x1 = SHA-512, 0x2 = SHA-512/224, 0x3 = SHA-512/256.

fields.name: CRYPTO_START
fields.text: Writing 1 starts processing the input data; the bit clears itself.

fields.name: CRYPTO_FETCH_ADDR
fields.text: Memory address the input data is read from; its value is updated as the calculation runs and output is written to memory.

fields.name: CRYPTO_LEN
fields.text: Input data length in bytes. A length that is not a whole number of blocks is padded with zeros. It is updated as the calculation runs and output is written to memory.

fields.name: CRYPTO_DEST_ADDR
fields.text: Memory address the result is written to; its value is updated as the calculation runs and output is written to memory.

fields.name: CRYPTO_IRQ_ST
fields.text: State of the block's interrupt request line: 0 = no request active, 1 = a request is pending.

fields.name: CRYPTO_WAIT_FOR_IN
fields.text: Set when the engine is stalled for more input, which happens with CRYPTO_MORE_IN = 1 and fragmented input: 0 = not waiting, 1 = waiting, with CRYPTO_INACTIVE held at 0 as the calculation is unfinished. Software then loads the next fragment into CRYPTO_FETCH_ADDR and CRYPTO_LEN and writes 1 to CRYPTO_START, which resumes the calculation and clears this flag.

fields.name: CRYPTO_INACTIVE
fields.text: Engine state: shows whether processing is still running or has ended.

fields.name: CRYPTO_CLRIRQ
fields.text: A write of 1 removes the pending interrupt request.

fields.name: CRYPTO_MREG0
fields.text: Mode-dependent word for AES: in CBC it holds IV[31:0], in CTR it holds CTRBLK[31:0], the starting value of the 32-bit counter. Meaningless in other modes.

fields.name: CRYPTO_MREG1
fields.text: Mode-dependent word for AES: in CBC it holds IV[63:32], in CTR it holds CTRBLK[63:32]. Meaningless in other modes.

fields.name: CRYPTO_MREG2
fields.text: Mode-dependent word for AES: in CBC it holds IV[95:64], in CTR it holds CTRBLK[95:64]. Meaningless in other modes.

fields.name: CRYPTO_MREG3
fields.text: Mode-dependent word for AES: in CBC it holds IV[127:96], in CTR it holds CTRBLK[127:96]. Meaningless in other modes.

fields.name: CRYPTO_KEY_X
fields.text: AES key storage memory, words CRYPTO_KEY_0 to CRYPTO_KEY_63; reachable over the AHB slave interface only while CRYPTO_INACTIVE = 1.
